title: 第五章 殖民治理术

zh: 农业合作社体现了殖民者与被殖民者双方的殖民梦想，这一梦想在社会实践中成为现实。合作社的社会计划构成了一种新的治理技术，殖民政权借此把共同体主义理念付诸实践，重新划定内部人与外部人的边界，重新分类土地所有权，并把失地农民转变为生产性劳动者与名义上的财产所有者。这种治理技术使殖民政权得以嵌入劳动与交换的日常活动，从而创造其社会权力。对满洲境内以及朝鲜、日本移居满洲的人口流动所施管理的规模，以及把各群体隔离在不同合作社中的做法，彰显了殖民政权的专制性质——它有能力组织人民在殖民地内部乃至整个帝国范围内的空间分布。
en: The agrarian cooperatives embodied a colonial dream of both the colonizer and the colonized, which was brought into being as social practices. The social program of the cooperatives constituted a new technology of governance, with which the colonial power put the idea of communitarianism into practice to redraw the boundary between insider and outsider, reclassify landownership, and transform displaced farmers into productive laborers and fictive property owners. This technology of governance enabled the colonial power to embed itself in the everyday activities of work and exchange and thus, create its social power. The scale of managing corporeal movement within Manchuria and from Korea and Japan to Manchuria and of quarantining the groups in separate cooperatives signified the despotic nature of the colonial power, which was capable of organizing the spatial distribution of people within a colony and across the entire empire.

zh: 在本章中，我考察这种压迫性的法西斯权力如何植根于社会领域。我聚焦于合作社本身内在的制度特征，而非强加于其上的外部力量。把专制的殖民权力仅仅归因于政治军事机构或殖民地臣民皇民化的意识形态，虽然对理解人民的新秩序很重要，却忽视了这样一个事实：帝国只有在其特定效果被制度化于一套社会实践之中时才得以存在，而正是这套社会实践使被殖民者能够做他们自己的梦想。社会权力把被殖民者卷入生产与交换的直接社会关系。正是通过这种社会权力，殖民当局把强制性统治插入被殖民者的梦想之中，使殖民权力一旦进入日常生活，便能在实践中自行增殖。
en: In this chapter, I examine the ways in which this repressive fascist power was grounded in the social sphere. I focus on the institutional characteristics immanent to the cooperatives themselves rather than on the external forces imposed on them. Although it is important for understanding the new order of people, to attribute the despotic colonial power solely to political and military institutions or the ideology of the imperialization of colonial subjects overlooks the fact that the empire existed only as long as its specific effects were institutionalized in a set of social practices that enabled the colonized to dream their own dreams. The social power implicated the colonized in the immediate social relations of production and exchange. It was through this social power that colonial authorities inserted coercive rule into the dream of the colonized, auto-valorizing the penetration of colonial power into daily life.

zh: 殖民当局的社会权力，由民族政治与资本主义发展两者所中介。上一章聚焦于民族中介；本章的讨论以资本主义发展对民族主权与殖民主权的中介为中心。在本章末尾，我阐释民族整合与资本主义整合的身体过程中的紧张，我称之为渗透政治。我还确立满洲的农业合作社、渗透与法西斯主义之间的联系。合作社由来自日本与朝鲜的产业资本和金融资本投资，宣称要把农民从先前（中国）地主与商人的暴虐中解放出来，尤其是从高地租、高利贷利息与市场垄断中解放出来。合作社因此成为制度手段，使殖民政权得以实现资本主义现代化，却不带来其过度，也不带来造成其结构性失衡的对抗。虽然这一法西斯梦想看似取消了支配阶级的代表政治，其新社会秩序却依照资本的逻辑凝聚而成。也就是说，合作社由满洲资本主义的三个相关特征所构成——即资本主义发展在满洲的历史特殊形式：金融资本对满洲农业的参与、名义上的私有财产制度，以及共同体信用制度。资本的中介造成了社会关系同质化与差异化这一矛盾过程，因而既催生了殖民治理术，也绕开了它的控制。
en: The social power of the colonial authorities was mediated by both national politics and capitalist development. The previous chapter focused on national mediation; the discussion in this chapter centers on the mediation of capitalist development on national and colonial sovereignty. At the end of this chapter, I explicate the tension in the corporeal process of national and capitalist integration, which I call the politics of osmosis. I also establish the connection between agrarian cooperatives, osmosis, and fascism in Manchuria. Invested by industrial and finance capital from Japan and Korea, the cooperatives claimed to liberate peasants from the tyranny of former (Chinese) landlords and merchants, especially high rents, excessive rates of usury, and market monopoly. The cooperatives were thus the institutional means through which the colonial power could bring about capitalist modernization without its excesses or without the antagonisms that caused its structural imbalance. While this fascist dream appeared to nullify the representational politics of the dominant classes, its new social order coalesced following the logic of capital. That is, the cooperatives were constituted by three related characteristics of Manchurian capitalism or a historically specific form of capitalist development in Manchuria: the participation of finance capital in Manchurian agriculture, the fictive private property system, and the communal credit system. The mediation of capital effected the contradictory processes of homogenizing and differentiating social relations, which therefore both gave rise to and circumvented colonial governmentality.

zh: 我聚焦于朝鲜人合作社，以探讨这一社会权力的殖民梦想。如第四章所讨论的，就体现农业共同体主义理想而言，朝鲜人合作社比中国人与日本人的同类更典型地体现了合作社政策。朝鲜人合作社由（名义上）自给自足的小农组成，而中国人与日本人的合作社则分别有很大比例的佃农与地主。在朝鲜人合作社中（除非另有说明，下文讨论的合作社均指此类），满洲内部的资本主义动态至少以三种相关方式使社会权力同质化：政策规划的经济理性、作为财产所有者的殖民臣民的生产，以及强制的技术。第一，合作社在诉诸前现代共同体主义的同时，表达了一种理性形式，它成为一种新的治理术文化。合作社的细致规划——涉及贷款的投资与分配及其额度与条件——是试图以尽可能低的成本行使权力、取得尽可能大的效果。第二，私有财产权在文化、象征和社会层面的运作产生了操演效果，被殖民者借此在持续商品化的农业生产过程中想象自己的主权。第三，贷款计划（自耕农创定计划，朝鲜语 Chajangnong ch'angjŏng，汉语 Zigengnong chuangding）与农务契（朝鲜语 Nongmugye，汉语 Nongwuqi）内在的信用制度，是强制的制度变形，它授权了一种新的规训主体形成。它们把剩余劳动的占有方式从地租体系转变为信用体系。信用制度强加了一种新的社会必要劳动时间，而农务契则以自治之名执行日常规训。
en: I focus on Korean cooperatives in order to explore this colonial dream of social power. As was discussed in chapter 4, Korean cooperatives epitomized the policy of the cooperatives better than their Chinese and Japanese counterparts in terms of embodying the ideal of agrarian communitarianism. Korean cooperatives consisted of (fictive) self-sustainable small farmers, while Chinese and Japanese ones had a large proportion of tenants and landlords, respectively. In Korean cooperatives (the cooperatives hereafter under discussion, if not otherwise specified), the capitalist dynamics within Manchuria homogenized social power in at least three related ways: the economic rationality of policy planning, the production of colonial subjects as property owners, and the technique of coercion. Firstly, while invoking premodern communitarianism, the cooperatives expressed a form of rationality that became a new culture of governmentality. The detailed planning of the cooperatives, involving the investment and distribution of loans and the amount and terms of them, was an attempt to exercise power at the lowest possible cost with the greatest possible effect. Second, the cultural, symbolic, and social operations of private property ownership enacted performativity, whereby the colonized imagined their sovereignty within the ongoing commodified process of agricultural production. Third, the credit system inherent in the loan program (the Program to Create Independent Farmers, Chajangnong ch’angjŏng in Korean, Zigengnong chuangding in Chinese) and the Mutual Aid Association (Nongmugye in Korean, Nongwuqi in Chinese) were the institutional metamorphosis of coercion that authorized a new disciplinary subject formation. They transformed the ways in which surplus labor was appropriated from the ground rent system to the credit system. While the credit system imposed a new, socially necessary labor time, the Mutual Aid Association performed everyday discipline in the name of self-rule.

zh: 尽管合作社的社会计划唤起了殖民治理的理性与制度化强制，却带来了与政策目标相反的结果，农民再度失地流离。这一同质化过程内在包含着社会关系的等级化，它由缺乏充分补偿的土地转移、贷给朝鲜人与日本人的贷款额度差距、以及中国人无法获得购地贷款所造成（见第四章）。这种等级制造了朝鲜人与中国人流离的另一条链条。朝鲜、日本与满洲农民的流离起初迫使殖民政权设计合作社，而合作社并未消除这场流离危机，却在满洲这一新边疆上重复了它。这种等级是对资本主义危机无效的空间解决方案的必要前提与产物。这一解决方案要求维持各地在资本主义整合中的比较优势，例如满洲的地价与生活水平低于朝鲜，朝鲜又低于日本。把人民空间再分配进合作社，产生了殖民治理术的新动态，在满洲国时期把渗透政治又推进了一步。但它未能调和领土整合与资本主义整合这两个相连的梦想。
en: Though it conjured up rationality and the institutionalized coercion of colonial governance, the social program of the cooperatives led to the opposite of the intended policy: the repetition of displacement. Inherent in this homogenization process was the hierarchization of social relations, which was produced by the transfer of land without adequate compensation, together with the disparity in the amount of loans lent to Koreans and Japanese and the unavailability of loans to the Chinese for the purchase of land (see chapter 4). The hierarchy produced another chain of displacement of Koreans and Chinese. Whereas the displacement of the peasants in Korea, Japan, and Manchuria impelled the colonial power to devise the cooperatives in the first place, the cooperatives did not eliminate this crisis of displacement but repeated it on the new frontier of Manchuria. The hierarchy was a necessary precondition and product of an ineffective spatial solution to the capitalist crisis. This solution required maintenance of the comparative advantage of places in the capitalist integration, such as the price of land and living standards being lower in Manchuria than in Korea and lower in Korea than in Japan. Producing the new dynamics of colonial governmentality, the spatial redistribution of people into the cooperatives took the politics of osmosis one step further during the Manchukuo period. But it fell short of harmonizing the two conjoined dreams of territorial and capitalist integration.

zh: 社会权力与资本主义网络
en: social power and the capitalist network

zh: 殖民政权的种种忧虑——种族暴乱、农民脱离土地、农业生产的中断，以及抗日力量的威胁——凝结为一个新社会秩序的核心要素，而这个新秩序由合作社的运营使之成为可能。在殖民话语中，合作社消除了任何形式的代表与中介。当“皇民化”（hwangminhwa）组织起被殖民臣民的新民族认同、迫使他们采用日本姓名并宣示对天皇的忠诚时，合作社却催生了殖民政权与其臣民之间一种新的超验关系。通过建立合作社，殖民政权宣称已解决困扰农民社会的一切问题，并已克服政治与社会的对抗。合作社的贷款计划取代了地主与商人的高利贷——正是它把农民拖入无法挣脱的债务循环。农作物的集体销售与必需品的集体购买，被宣传为铲除商人市场垄断的手段。这些经济改革被期望稳定满洲国包括朝鲜人在内的所有成员的生活。政治的消除贬抑了先前支配阶级的政治经济权力——他们在1931年之前曾同时与日本权力合作又对抗。预示合作社的那种铲除种族、政治与社会对抗的愿望，为殖民当局的法西斯权力奠定了基础。在这类殖民话语中，外部与内部的划界被消解了。
en: The preoccupations of the colonial power—racial riots, the displacement of peasants from land, the disruption of agricultural production, and the threat of the anti-Japanese forces—congealed into core elements of a new social order that was made possible by the operation of the cooperatives. In the colonial discourses, the cooperatives eliminated any kind of representation and mediation. While “imperialization” (hwangminhwa) organized a new national identity of colonized subjects, forcing them to adopt Japanese names and proclaim their loyalty to the emperor, the cooperatives engendered a new, transcendental relationship between the colonial power and its subjects. By establishing the cooperatives, the colonial power claimed to have resolved all the problems that had afflicted peasant society and to have overcome political and social antagonism. The loan program of the cooperatives replaced the usury of landlords and merchants that had brought the peasants into an unbreakable cycle of indebtedness. The collective sale of crops and the purchase of necessities were promoted as the means to eradicate the market monopoly of merchants. These economic reforms were expected to stabilize the lives of all members of the Manchukuo state, including Koreans. The elimination of politics debased the political and economic power of the former dominant classes, which had simultaneously collaborated with and opposed Japanese power prior to 1931. The desire to eradicate racial, political, and social antagonism that prefigured the cooperatives laid the groundwork for the fascist power of the colonial authorities. In such colonial discourses, the demarcation of outside and inside was dissolved.

zh: 近年来在中国与韩国出版的满洲朝鲜人民族史学，与这种殖民话语针锋相对。它们认同这样一种观点：合作社不过是欺骗性装置，并未改变对抗的基本轴线，反而以地租、无偿劳动、高利贷与赋税的形式，加深了地主及其恩主——殖民政权——那种熟悉的封建剥削。开发公司利润的最大化，主要依靠延长耕作劳动时间，以及延长住房、设施与道路等基础设施建设和防卫团体组织中的劳动时间。据说，这种条件下的农民陷入与奴隶相差无几的生活。
据孙春日所言，贷款计划从未让一个朝鲜人成为土地所有者，因为原贷款的偿还期定为十至二十年，而朝鲜人在此之前就已从日本统治下解放。
即便没有解放，土地所有权也是不切实际的梦想，因为贷款只会导致更多债务。首先，被安置进合作社的朝鲜人几乎一无所有，从衣食到种子、农具，一切都不得不借债购买。他们按期偿还贷款与利息，却只是为了借得更多。
en: The national historiographies of Koreans in Manchuria, which have been published in China and Korea in recent years, have diametrically challenged this colonial discourse. They subscribe to a view that the cooperatives were nothing but deceptive devices that did not change the fundamental axes of antagonism but deepened the familiar feudal exploitation in the form of rent, unpaid labor, usury, and taxes by landlords and their benefactor, the colonial power. Maximization of profits by the development companies depended largely on lengthening hours of work in cultivation, as well as in the construction of infrastructure such as housing, facilities, and roads and the organization of defense groups. Peasants under such conditions were said to be trapped in a life not much different from that of slavery.

According to Son Ch’unil, the loan program never allowed a single Korean to become a landowner, since the repayment of the original loan was set for ten to twenty years and they were liberated from Japan before that time.

Even without liberation, landownership was an unrealistic dream, as the loans merely led to more debt. To begin with, Koreans who were relocated in cooperatives possessed almost nothing and had to borrow to purchase everything from food and clothing to seeds and farming tools. They made the required payments on the loans and interest only to borrow more.

zh: 朴昌昱（Pak Ch'angwuk）无疑是中国撰写朝鲜族共同体历史最受推崇的历史学家，他在对自耕农创定计划的权威批判中，认为该计划是以高利贷形式进行封建剥削的主要机制。

他把这种封建机制与资本主义农场相对照，以凸显合作社远远未能兑现现代化承诺的种种方式。殖民开发公司的行为简直与其前身——旧地主——如出一辙，实行各种形式的剥削。开发公司把土地以远高于购入价的价格贷售给农民。它们还通过从农务契低价收购农作物、再以更高价格在市场出售来攫取利润。合作社中的农民不仅继续作为开发公司的佃农生活，还被剥夺了离开的自由。如果说他们像被债务奴役的奴隶一样劳作，那么资本主义农场上的同类则是与土地分离的“自由”劳动者——他们与生产资料相异化，被雇佣为农业劳工。
en: In his authoritative critique of the Program to Create Independent Farmers, Pak Ch’angwuk, undoubtedly the most acclaimed historian in China writing about the history of the Korean Chinese community, considers the program to have been a major mechanism of feudal exploitation in the form of usury.

He contrasts this feudal mechanism and the capitalist farms to highlight the ways in which the cooperatives fell far short of the promise of modernization. The colonial development companies simply behaved like their predecessors, the former landlords, practicing various forms of exploitation. The development companies distributed land as loans at much higher prices than they had paid. They also appropriated the profits by purchasing crops at low prices from the Mutual Aid Association and selling them at higher prices on the market. The peasants in the cooperatives did not just continue to live as tenants of the development companies, but they were also deprived of the freedom to leave them. If they worked like slaves held in bondage by debt, their counterparts on the capitalist farms were “free” of the land, as they were alienated from the means of production and employed as agricultural laborers.

zh: 把农业改革化约为殖民者创造乌托邦式资本主义发展的愿望，或把它们归因于老一套的封建主义，都无法说明改革在被殖民者与殖民者关系上带来的新的、特殊的制度变化。合作社及其贷款计划涉及一种历史特殊的资本主义动态。我的问题归根结底不是日本如何成功地通过政治军事强制加剧剥削并消解朝鲜人的抵抗，而是其社会计划如何把殖民政权的主权嵌入社会领域。合作社必须被解读为国家塑造社会经验、规训殖民臣民的一种策略。
en: Reducing the agrarian reforms to the colonizer’s desire to create a utopian capitalist development or attributing them to the same old feudalism does not account for the new and specific institutional changes in the relationship between the colonized and the colonizer brought about by the reforms. The cooperatives and their loan program involved a historically specific capitalist dynamic. My question ultimately is not how Japan successfully intensified exploitation and siphoned off the resistance of Koreans through political and military coercion but rather how its social program embedded the sovereignty of the colonial power in the social sphere. The cooperatives must be read as a strategy of the state to shape social experience and discipline colonial subjects.

zh: 合作社的乌托邦计划，依赖国家把地方经济与资本主义全球动态隔绝开来的绝对能力。它提供了一个语境，使共同体主义与私有财产制度被想象为可以共存。名义上的私有财产制度与信用制度构成了殖民治理术，生产出新的主体性与规训技术。由于这些变化，人们切身经历的资本主义转型所呈现的复杂性，远非“无过度的资本主义现代化”或“封建剥削”等概念所能说明。殖民权力在社会空间中的嵌入，使殖民主权与主体性得以阐释。当合作社中的生产与交换要独立于土地和劳动力的商品化来进行时，它塑造了殖民政权的一种特殊主权。合作社的社会计划也在生产者中培育了一种特殊形式的主体性。关于合作社的这些特征是否否定了农民劳动力及其社会关系的对象化的讨论，必须包括由金融资本中介的殖民者与被殖民者之间的制度网络。
en: The utopian project of the cooperatives relied on the state’s absolute capacity to insulate the local economy from the global dynamics of capitalism. It provided a context in which communitarianism and the system of private property were imagined to coexist. The system of fictive private property and the credit system constituted colonial governmentality, producing new subjectivities and techniques of discipline. Because of such changes, the lived experience of capitalist transformation manifested far more complexity than is accounted for by notions of capitalist modernization without excess or feudal exploitation. The embedding of colonial power in the social space enables an explication of colonial sovereignty and subjectivity. When production and exchange in the cooperatives were to be carried out independent of the commodification of land and labor power, it shaped a particular sovereignty of the colonial power. Social programs of the cooperatives also fostered a specific form of subjectivity among producers. The discussion of whether these features of cooperatives negated the objectification of peasants’ labor power and their social relations must include the institutional network between the colonizer and the colonized mediated by finance capital.

zh: 金字塔式的制度网络
en: A Pyramidal Institutional Network

zh: 朝鲜人与朝鲜总督府及其机构发展出自己的制度网络。满洲的金融组织包括银行、金融合作社、当铺，以及粮栈（liangchan）。满洲的朝鲜人必定利用过当铺与粮栈——它们是穷人中间流行的贷款来源。此外，朝鲜人与朝鲜总督府发展出一种独特的制度网络，为朝鲜人创造了一个与满洲其他居民相分离的社会空间。朝鲜总督府在满洲的机构装置包括开发公司、朝鲜人民会、金融会（朝鲜语 kŭmyunghoe，汉语 jinronghui）与农务契。这些装置受其直接上级控制，形成严格的金字塔式秩序。它们倡导朝鲜农民生活的稳定化、现代化与合理化。然而，它们对朝鲜总督府与日本帝国的实际功能，往往偏离所宣称的目标。甚至在1931年之前，金融网络就已是朝鲜总督府得以对间岛地区朝鲜农民确立主权的主要机制（第三章）。1932年后，这一金融网络继续强化朝鲜总督府与满洲朝鲜人之间的关系，并有两个重大变化：它扩展到间岛地区之外，也比以往更加合理化。下一节我将聚焦开发公司与农务契对殖民主权与主体性的影响。这里先把它们置于金字塔式网络之中。
en: Koreans developed their own institutional network with the Government General of Korea and its apparatuses. The financial organizations in Manchuria included banks, the Financial Cooperative Company, pawnshops, and the grain stores called the liangchan. Koreans in Manchuria must have utilized pawnshops and grain stores, which were popular sources of loans among the poor. In addition, Koreans developed a distinctive institutional network with the Government General of Korea, which created a social space for Koreans separate from that of other Manchuria residents. The institutional apparatuses of the Government General of Korea in Manchuria included the development companies, the Korean Association, the Financial Association (kŭmyunghoe in Korean, jinronghui in Chinese), and the Mutual Aid Association. Controlled by their immediate superiors, the apparatuses formed a strict pyramidal order. They advocated the stabilization, modernization, and rationalization of Korean peasant lives. Their actual function for the Government General of Korea and the Japanese empire, however, often digressed from the stated objectives. Even prior to 1931 the financial network had been a primary mechanism through which the Government General of Korea could establish its sovereignty over Korean peasants in the Kando region (chapter 3). After 1932, this financial network continued to strengthen the relationship between the Government General of Korea and the Koreans of Manchuria, with two significant changes. It had expanded beyond the Kando region, and it was also more rationalized than before. I will focus on the effects of the development companies and Mutual Aid Association on colonial sovereignty and subjectivity in the next section. Here I situate them in the pyramidal network.

zh: 首先，开发公司——间岛的东洋拓殖株式会社与南满的东亚劝业株式会社——分别在间岛及满洲其他地方购置并管理土地。开发公司的官方职能包括购置与管理土地、建设合作社。作为金融机构运作时，它们还以朝鲜农民的土地为抵押，向其发放贷款。1936年，东亚劝业株式会社与东洋拓殖株式会社把朝鲜人事务移交给满鲜拓殖株式会社，后者本身又于1941年并入满洲拓殖公社。
en: To begin with, the development companies—the Oriental Development Company in Kando and the Asia Development Company in South Manchuria—had acquired and managed land in Kando and other parts of Manchuria, respectively. The official roles of the development companies included the purchase and management of land and the construction of the cooperatives. Functioning as financial institutions, they also advanced loans to Korean peasants, taking their lands as collateral security. In 1936, the Asia Development Company and the Oriental Development Company transferred their work on Koreans to the Manchuria-Korea Development Company, which itself was incorporated into the Manchuria Development Corporation in 1941.

zh: 朝鲜人民会自1910年前后起受朝鲜总督府与日本间岛总领事馆监督（第三章）。在朝鲜总督府与日本外务省的补贴下，朝鲜人民会从1931年的34个分会扩展到1935年的113个（会员128,990人），当时满洲朝鲜人家庭的官方估计数为152,873户（830,601人）。
鉴于只有户主加入该会，会员覆盖了官方估计的朝鲜人家庭总数的约 84%。虽然这一朝鲜人口官方数字仅相当于到1945年通常估计的150万或200万的一半，但它显示了该会对朝鲜人的影响力。
en: The Korean Association had been supervised by the Government General of Korea and the Japanese consulate general in Kando since around 1910 (chapter 3). With a subsidy from the Government General of Korea and the Japanese Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Korean Association expanded from 34 branches in 1931 to 113 (with 128,990 members) in 1935, when the official number of Korean households in Manchuria was estimated at 152,873 (830,601 individuals).

Given that only the head of the household joined the association, it enrolled about 84 percent of the total Korean population. While this official figure for the Korean population amounted to only half of the usual estimates of 1.5 million or 2 million by 1945, it suggests the influential power of the association over Koreans.

zh: 朝鲜人民会为殖民政权执行各种行政事务，直到1936年其除教育与风俗相关职能外的全部职能移交给满洲国政权。

其官方职能包括：教育；居民福利活动，例如消防、安置穷人、收容无家可归者；运营公共设施（墓地与火葬场）；控制传染病（疫苗接种与隔离感染者）；以及支持农业（新农法指导、农作物与牲畜市场的运营、灌溉系统的建设与管理）。它不仅向朝鲜人通报满洲政策与法律的变化，还报道朝鲜的政治、经济与文化。朝鲜人的治外法权被废除时，其刊物以数期篇幅讨论这一主题，并提出各种政策建议。此外，管理合作社是该会的一项主要任务。它为合作社寻找合适地点，挑选合适人选。正如朝鲜人民会的月刊所示，它不断调查适合稻作的土地，并逐年预测收成。
en: The Korean Association performed various administrative tasks for the colonial power until all its functions except those concerning education and customs were passed to the Manchukuo state in 1936.

Its official functions consisted of education, activities for residents’ welfare, for example, firefighting, relocating poor people, accommodating the homeless, operating public facilities (cemeteries and crematoria), controlling contagious disease (vaccinations and quarantine of the infected), and supporting farming (instructions in new farming methods, the operations of markets for crops and livestock, and the construction and management of irrigation systems). It not only informed Koreans of changing policies and laws in Manchuria but also reported on politics, the economy, and culture in Korea. When the extraterritoriality of Koreans was abolished, its publications devoted several issues to the subject and made a variety of policy recommendations. In addition, the management of the cooperatives was a primary task of the association. It searched for proper locations for the cooperatives and selected suitable candidates for them. As the monthly publications of the Korean Association illustrate, it incessantly investigated lands suitable for rice farming and made annual projections of the harvest.

zh: 朝鲜人民会还在金融机构与朝鲜农民之间充当中介。它筛选向开发公司申请贷款的人，并监督金融会（Kŭmyunghoe）。金融会融资的贷款不同于开发公司的贷款，尽管两者都为农民购买基本必需品提供资金援助。开发公司负责发放安置初期的贷款，主要面向进入农业合作社的朝鲜人，也有例外。它们发放农田、住房与仓库、学校等集体设施贷款，以及牲畜、初期耕作费用与食品贷款。相比之下，金融会为合作社内外的朝鲜人提供各种常规贷款，包括用于偿付开发公司贷款本息的款项与耕作费用贷款。金融会也不同于金融部（Kŭmyungbu）：前者提供无抵押贷款，后者则像正规银行一样运作，要求抵押或担保人，因而只服务少数富裕农民。
en: The Korean Association also mediated between financial institutions and Korean peasants. It screened applicants who requested loans from development companies and oversaw the Financial Association (Kŭmyunghoe). The loans financed by the Financial Association differed from those of the development companies, although both offered peasants financial assistance for the purchase of basic necessities. The development companies were responsible for startup loans, mainly, though not exclusively, for Koreans who were brought into the agrarian cooperatives. They distributed loans for farmland, housing, and collective facilities such as storage buildings and schools, as well as livestock, initial farming expenses, and foodstuffs. In comparison, the Financial Association provided Koreans inside and outside the cooperatives with a variety of regular loans, including funds to meet the payments on loans from the development companies and loans for farming expenses. The Financial Association also differed from the Financial Department (Kŭmyungbu): the former proffered the loans without collateral, while the latter functioned like the regular banks, requiring security or guarantors and thus serving only a few rich farmers.

zh: 以合理化农民生活为官方目标，金融会力图以其贷款取代肆虐的高利贷体系——贷款用于购地及耕牛、化肥等改良耕作所需的物资，并资助植棉与纺织等副业。金融会以朝鲜的金融组合（朝鲜语 kŭmyung chohap，汉语 jinrongzuhe）为范本，而后者对小农的实际影响至多只能说毁誉参半。
金融组合虽承诺减轻地主高利贷给小农造成的苦难，却注定沦为更新熟悉剥削形式的又一机制。它们的贷款加速了农民脱离土地，因为债务人违约时合作社会没收其土地。金融组合以低利率向地主放贷，使地主得以向农民发放更多高利贷。在朝鲜总督府与开发公司的支持下，金融会迅速遍布满洲。例如，其1939年2月的二十三个分支（十五个主办事处与八个支处）到8月增至二十九个。
1939 年后，金融会适用（中国人的）金融合作社的法规。
en: With the official objective of rationalizing peasant lives, the Financial Association sought to replace the abusive usury system with its loans for the purchase of land and other goods necessary to improve farming, such as oxen and fertilizer, and to finance subsidiary businesses such as cotton growing and weaving. The Financial Association was modeled after the Financial Cooperative (kŭmyung chohap in Korean, jinrongzuhe in Chinese) of Korea, whose real impact on small farmers turned out to be equivocal at best.

While the Financial Cooperative pledged to alleviate the suffering of small farmers caused by landlords’ usury, they were condemned to become yet another mechanism that renewed familiar forms of exploitation. Their loans expedited the displacement of farmers from land, as the cooperative appropriated the land if debtors defaulted on their loans. Lending capital to landlords at low interest rates, the Financial Cooperative enabled them to make more usurious loans to peasants. With the support of the Government General of Korea and the development companies, the Financial Association quickly spread throughout Manchuria. For example, its twenty-three branches (fifteen main offices and eight subdivisions) in February 1939 grew to twentynine in August.
The Financial Association was subject to the laws and regulations of the (Chinese) Financial Cooperative Company after 1939.

zh: 贷款一旦发放给朝鲜农民个人，农务契便接手向开发公司偿还本息，同时向农民提供贷款。农务契在朝鲜总督府与日本奉天总领事馆的监督下设立，再造了称为契（kye）的朝鲜传统互助体系——成员在其中动员资金或劳力，以换取耕作、丧葬或其他需要大量资源的事务上的帮助。朝鲜总督府是农务契贷给社员资本的主要来源。
例如，安全农村农务契总支出38,000圆中，它补贴了24,445圆，其余由社员集体融资。农务契正式誓言通过稳定朝鲜人的职业与生活条件，防止他们脱离土地。它还履行政治职能，其团队成员须报告村民与抗日力量的一切接触。它的另一项基本职能是向开发公司偿还农业贷款。
以促进合作社内外朝鲜人自治为名，该会从社员手中收取收成（扣除留作家用的一部分），在市场上出售农作物，按期偿付贷款，再把剩余现金或农作物返还各户。
en: Once the loans were made to individual Korean peasants, the Mutual Aid Association took charge of repaying the principal and interest to the development companies while furnishing the loans to the peasants. Established under the supervision of the Government General of Korea and the Japanese consulate general in Fengtian, the Mutual Aid Association reinvented the customary Korean mutual support system called kye, in which members mobilized funds or labor in exchange for help with farming, funerals, or other events that required substantial resources. The Government General of Korea was the main source of the capital that the Mutual Aid Association lent to its members.

For instance, it subsidized 24,445 won out of a total of 38,000 of expenses of the Mutual Aid Association in the safety villages, leaving the rest to collective finance by its members. The Mutual Aid Association officially vowed to prevent displacement of Koreans from their land by stabilizing their jobs and living conditions. It also performed political functions, and its team members were required to report all villager contact with anti-Japanese forces. Another of its basic functions was the repayment of agricultural loans to the development companies.

In the name of promoting self-rule among Koreans inside and outside the cooperatives, the association collected the harvest from its members (less a quantity reserved for domestic consumption), sold the crops on the market, made the required payments on the loans, and returned the balance of cash or crops to each household.

zh: 农务契以不同名称在满洲全境组织起来，每户朝鲜家庭出一名代表，覆盖安全农村、集团部落及朝鲜人聚居的其他地区。1935年在吉林省的安全农村与合作社中设立后，农务契遍布满洲。成立三个月内，它已有156个分会，向其3,668名社员放贷236,947日元。
虽然每个分会预期由不足三十户组成，每十至十四个分会编成一个联合会，实际社员数却各不相同。安全农村的分会服务二十五至三十户，其他地区的社员数从七户到七十户不等。
1937年朝鲜人治外法权被废除后，该会受中国人经营的兴安合作社监督，其职能则由满鲜拓殖株式会社监控与规制。满鲜拓殖株式会社把安全农村的管理委托给农务契联合会。

children: 〔校注〕此处记为 1937 年废除朝鲜人的治外法权。第四章说 1935 年初大多数朝鲜人已失去这一权利，所述范围有别。

en: Under different names, the Mutual Aid Association was organized with one representative from each Korean household throughout Manchuria, including the safety villages, collective villages, and other areas where Koreans congregated. After its establishment in the safety villages and cooperatives in Jilin Province in 1935, the Mutual Aid Association spread throughout Manchuria. Within three months of its creation it had 156 branches and lent 236,947 yen to its 3,668 members.
By August 1936, there were 319 branches with a total of 10,804 members.

Although each branch was expected to consist of less than thirty households and every ten to fourteen branches were grouped into a federation, the actual membership varied. The branches in the safety villages served twenty-five to thirty households, while membership in other areas ranged from seven to seventy.

After the extraterritoriality of Koreans was abolished in 1937, the association was subject to the administrative supervision of the Chinese Hungan Cooperative Company, while its functions were monitored and regulated by the Manchuria-Korea Development Company. The Manchuria-Korea Development Company entrusted the Federation of Mutual Aid Associations with the management of the safety villages.

zh: 在殖民制度金字塔的底层，农务契使殖民政权得以实现殖民梦想，渗入农民的日常生活。当然，殖民机构的制度网络并不完全为殖民政权服务。例如，农务契的一些领导者是朝鲜民族主义者，他们用自己的房屋藏匿共产主义游击队员、策划抗日活动。
人们反复讲述，朝鲜农民冒着生命危险把部分农作物送给抗日游击队，藏匿其成员，并提供日军与警察的情报。我不否认朝鲜人在反抗殖民统治斗争中的英勇，但我力图考察：殖民机构及其制度网络不仅压制被殖民者、掩盖被殖民者所受的剥削，还生产出殖民主权与主体性的特殊形式与内容。在展开这一分析之前，下一节讨论渗透于满洲全境朝鲜人私有财产与信用制度之中的金融资本的中介。
en: At the bottom of the pyramid of colonial institutions, the Mutual Aid Association enabled the colonial power to actualize the colonial dream and penetrate into the everyday life of peasants. The institutional network of the colonial apparatuses did not, of course, completely serve the colonial power. For example, some leaders of the Mutual Aid Association were Korean nationalists, who used their houses to hide communist guerrillas and plan anti-Japanese activities.

It was repeatedly said that Korean peasants risked their lives in delivering some of their crops to anti-Japanese guerrilla armies, hiding their members and providing intelligence on the Japanese military and police. While I do not dispute the Koreans’ bravery in the struggle against colonial rule, I seek to examine the ways in which the colonial apparatuses and their institutional network did not merely repress the colonized and conceal their exploitation but also produced the specific forms and content of colonial sovereignty and subjectivity. Before undertaking this analysis, the next section discusses the mediation of finance capital that pervaded the systems of private property and credit among Koreans across Manchuria.

zh: 金融资本
en: Finance Capital

zh: 金融资本早在1936年就成为殖民政权的重要伙伴。正是通过这一伙伴关系，殖民政权与朝鲜人之间的制度关系得以巩固。金融资本支撑了陷入财政困难的开发公司，使它们得以扩大此前仅限于间岛地区的对朝鲜人贷款计划。信用制度的这一空间扩展，意味着殖民政权日益渗入满洲全境朝鲜人的社会生活。来自朝鲜与日本的金融资本参与满洲开发，恰逢关东军——满洲事实上的最高权力——与日本垄断资本之间此消彼长的权力关系的关键转变。1920—1929年间，财阀（三井、三菱、住友、安田等公司）见证了其财富与政治权力的巨大扩张，而关东军的权力则因1918年与德国冲突中的失败、以及1918—1923年在中国与西伯利亚的又一次挫折而衰落。始于1920年代末的经济萧条与关东军1931年对满洲的入侵，逆转了军队与财阀之间的权力动态。关东军构想满洲的计划经济，把财阀排除在满洲开发之外。

children: 〔校注〕印本记述关东军因 1918 年与德国的冲突失利而衰落，此说存疑。财阀名 Sumitonomo 按通常写法译作“住友”。

en: Finance capital emerged as an important partner of the colonial power as early as 1936. It was through this partnership that the institutional relationship between the colonial power and Koreans was consolidated. Finance capital buttressed the development companies, which had experienced financial difficulties, and enabled them to expand the loan program for Koreans, which previously had been confined to the Kando area. This spatial extension of the credit system signified the increasing infiltration of the colonial power into the social life of Koreans across Manchuria. The participation of finance capital from Korea and Japan in the development of Manchuria coincided with a crucial shift in the seesawing relationship between the Kwantung Army–the de facto supreme power in Manchuria–and Japanese monopoly capital. For the period 1920–29, the Zaibatsu (companies such as Mitsui, Mitsubishi, Sumitonomo, and Yasuda) witnessed an enormous expansion of their wealth and political power, while the Kwantung Army’s power waned due to its defeat in the clash with Germany in 1918 and another setback in China and Siberia during 1918–23. The economic depression that began in the late 1920s and the Kwantung Army’s invasion of Manchuria in 1931 reversed the dynamics of power between the army and the Zaibatsu. Envisaging a planned economy for Manchuria, the Kwantung Army excluded the Zaibatsu from Manchuria’s development.

zh: 1906年至1935年，南满洲铁道株式会社一直是满洲开发所需资本的主要来源。满铁以2亿日元资本成立，其中一半来自日本政府；到1931年末，对满铁及其子公司的投资约占日本全部投资的85%，1932年至1935年占68%。
至少到1920年代末，满铁一直维持着高利润运营。马若孟（Ramon Myers）指出，在偿付对债券持有人的全部年度义务并计入其他债务与损失之后，满铁每年仍产生可观的净收入，并在二十世纪第二个和第三个十年迅速翻番、增至三倍。

其收入在1930年代初的意外下滑可归因于两个因素。第一，它的许多经济活动利润丰厚，但为新投资提供的资金，主要来自发行债券和募集实缴资本，留存收益的贡献较小。虽然铁路的管理与运营是其主要活动，满铁却投资于满洲的矿山、电力与工厂，据 F.C. 琼斯所言，其中许多是“不经济”或“无利可图”的企业，例如鞍山制铁所、铁路附属地的行政与社会服务、这些附属地及关东租借地的日本殖民定居点，以及抚顺煤炭液化与昭和制钢所等某些收益微薄的企业。
第二，满铁被日本国家强迫接管中东铁路、投资新线建设，并限制运费以便利大豆运输。这些代价高昂的变化发生在1920年代末市场萎缩之际，使其难以在日本发行债券筹集更多资金。1932—1937年间，满铁保持其在满洲开发中的主要份额，但满洲国政权作为一个竞争者出现，成为其设立的十九家关键特殊公司——包括满洲中央银行、满洲电信电话株式会社与一家汽车公司——的主要或重要股东。
en: From 1906 to 1935, the South Manchuria Railway Company had been a main source of the capital needed for the development of Manchuria. Since it was formed with capital of 200 million yen, half of which came from the Japanese government, investment in the smrc and its subsidiaries reached about 85 percent of all Japanese investment in late 1931 and 68 percent from 1932 to 1935.

The smrc maintained its highly profitable operations at least until the late 1920s. Ramon Myers states that after paying all its annual obligations to bondholders and accounting for other debts and losses, the smrc still generated significant net revenue each year, rapidly doubling and tripling it in the second and third decades of the century.

The unexpected decline in its revenue in the early 1930s can be attributed to two factors. First, many of its economic activities yielded large profits, but retained earnings did not contribute as much to new financial investment as did the issuance of new debt in the forms of bonds and paid-in capital. Although the management and operation of railways were its main activities, the smrc invested in mines, electricity, and factories in Manchuria, many of which, according to F.C. Jones, included “uneconomic” or “unprofitable” enterprises, such as the Anshan Iron Works, administrative and social services in the railway zones, Japanese colonization settlements in these zones and the Kwantung Leased Territory, and certain “marginal” enterprises such as coal liquefaction at Fushun and the Showa Steel Works.

Second, the smrc was forced by the Japanese state to take over the Chinese Eastern Railway, invest in the construction of new lines, and limit the freight fee so as to facilitate the transportation of soybeans. Such costly changes took place while the market was contracting in the late 1920s, which made it difficult to issue bonds in Japan to raise more funds. During 1932–37, the smrc retained its principal share in the development of Manchuria, but the Manchukuo state emerged as a competitor that became either a principal or an important shareholder in nineteen key special companies established by it, including the Central Bank, the Manchurian Telegraph and Telephone Company, and an automobile company.

zh: 尽管财政恶化，满铁仍是开发公司的主要股东。它资助东亚劝业株式会社——后者自1922年起购置并管理土地，自1932年起在南满建设合作社。东亚劝业株式会社1932年录得巨额亏损，资产价值缩水一半，从2,000万圆降至1,000万圆。

东亚劝业株式会社的职能被新的开发公司——鲜满拓殖株式会社及其辅助公司满鲜拓殖株式会社——所吸收，这两家公司由关东军与朝鲜总督府设立，以启动1936年朝鲜人从朝鲜向满洲的官方移民。在鲜满拓殖株式会社中，满铁与东洋拓殖株式会社合计持有近一半股份（40万股中分别持10万股与99,900股）。东洋拓殖株式会社1932年至1935年因世界经济萧条及随后的农产品价格下跌而遭受相当大的财务亏损，地租收入随之减少。从1930年代中期起，由于扩大对矿山、造船、化学与金属工业、电力及运输的投资，其财政状况好转。
en: Despite its financial deterioration, the smrc remained the main stockholder of the development companies. It financed the Asia Development Company, which had acquired and managed land since 1922, and had been constructing cooperatives since 1932 in South Manchuria. The Asia Development Company recorded a dramatic loss in 1932, shrinking the value of its assets by half, from 20 to 10 million won.

The functions of the Asia Development Company were absorbed by the new development companies —the Korea-Manchuria Development Company and its auxiliary firm, the Manchuria-Korea Development Company—which the Kwantung Army and the Government General of Korea established to launch the official immigration of Koreans from Korea to Manchuria in 1936. The smrc, together with the Oriental Development Company, owned almost half of its stock (100,000 and 99,900 shares, respectively, out of 400,000) in the Korea-Manchuria Development Company. The Oriental Development Company experienced sizable financial losses from 1932 to 1935 due to the worldwide economic depression and the subsequent decline in agricultural prices, which reduced its rental income. Starting in the mid-1930s its financial condition improved, due to its expanded investment in mines, shipbuilding, chemical and metal industries, electricity, and transportation.

zh: 金融资本对开发公司日益增长的投资，锻造了一个涉及殖民政权与朝鲜人的新资本主义网络。鉴于满铁仍是主要股东，产业资本仍是殖民政权的重要伙伴。但与早先的开发公司相比，鲜满拓殖株式会社的非同寻常之处，在于它包含大比例的金融资本。朝鲜与日本的十一家保险公司和六家银行合计持有约50%的股份，占股东数的74%。
金融资本对鲜满拓殖株式会社的投资，结束了满铁在满洲开发中长达三十年的垄断，预示着金融资本至少在满洲农业中日益增长的影响。从1930年代中期起，满铁趋弱的财务状况迫使关东军邀请新财阀（钢铁、金属与化学工业）以及既有产业集团投资满洲。
虽然财阀并不投资开发公司，但资本与军队关系的整体重组，正是金融资本作为有影响力的角色出现在满洲农业中的背景。
en: A new capitalist network involving the colonial power and the Koreans was forged by the growing investment of finance capital in the development companies. Given that the smrc remained a primary stockholder, industrial capital remained an important partner of the colonial power. But compared to earlier development companies the Korea-Manchuria Development Company was extraordinary in its inclusion of a large proportion of finance capital. A total of eleven insurance companies and six banks in Korea and Japan comprised about 50 percent of the total stock and 74 percent of the stockholders.

The investment of finance capital in the Korea-Manchuria Development Company ended a three-decade monopoly by the smrc in the development of Manchuria, heralding the growing influence of finance capital at least in Manchurian agriculture. From the mid-1930s on, the weakened financial position of the smrc forced the Kwantung Army to invite new Zaibatsu (in the steel, metal, and chemical industries), as well as existing industrial conglomerates, to invest in Manchuria.

While the Zaibatsu did not invest in development companies, the overall restructuring of the relationship between capital and the army was the context in which finance capital emerged as an influential player in Manchurian agriculture.

zh: 赋予鲜满拓殖株式会社的职责规模大于其前身。鲜满拓殖株式会社既监管间岛地区以外的旧合作社，也监管为新移民建立的新合作社。在其前身东亚劝业株式会社多年承诺未兑现之后，它还把旨在把佃农转变为自耕农的贷款计划（自耕农创定计划）扩展到间岛地区以外。此外，鲜满拓殖株式会社管理朝鲜新移民的搬迁与定居，按官方政策，这些新移民预期在十五年内达到二十万户。尽管职能规模更大，鲜满拓殖株式会社的原始资本2,000万圆却与十五年前1922年成立的东亚劝业株式会社相等。事实上，若考虑1920年代末的高通胀，前者的资产估值还低于后者。
en: The scale of the responsibilities assigned to the Korea-Manchuria Development Company was greater than its predecessors. The Korea-Manchuria Development Company oversaw both the old cooperatives outside the Kando region and the new ones built for new immigrants. It also extended the loan program (the Program to Create Independent Farmers) aimed at turning tenants into self-cultivators beyond the Kando region, after years of unfulfilled promises by its predecessor, the Asia Development Company. In addition, the Korea-Manchuria Development Company managed the relocation and settlement of new Korean immigrants, who under the official policy were expected to amount to 200,000 households over fifteen years. In spite of the larger scale of its function, the Korea-Manchuria Development Company’s original capital of 20 million won was equal to that of the Asia Development Company, which had been established fifteen years earlier in 1922. In fact, the former’s assets were valued at less than those of the latter, if the high inflation of the late 1920s was considered.

zh: 鲜满拓殖株式会社的规模，与其说在于资本投资量本身，不如说在于它对合作社规划与管理的合理化。让合作社的功能超出遏制抗日力量的，是具有金字塔形结构的殖民机构所构成的新资本主义网络。这个网络催生了新的社会关系。这一新资本主义网络在满洲全境颁布私有财产与信用制度，使作为准财产所有者的国民的制度位置与身份同质化，并组织劳动过程。换言之，金融网络所做的不止是为朝鲜农民的耕作与生活费用融资。它构成了殖民治理术。
en: The scale of the Korea-Manchuria Development Company was due not so much to the volume of capital investment per se as to its rationalization of the planning and management of the cooperatives. If the cooperatives were anything more than an effective means of containing anti-Japanese forces, it was because of the social relations made possible by the new capitalist network of pyramidal colonial institutions. This new capitalist network promulgated the systems of private property and credit across Manchuria, which homogenized the institutional positions and identities of nationals as prospective property owners and organized the labor process. In other words, the financial network accomplished more than financing the farming and living expenses of Korean peasants. It constituted colonial governmentality.

zh: 治理术的（不）可见空间秩序
en: the (in)visible spatial order of governmentality

zh: 农业合作社的建筑装置，赋予被殖民者与殖民者之间的权力关系以可见形式。每个合作社的空间设计都包含一个自我封闭的村落，充当一种社会隔离。大门、道路、相同的房屋、集体设施与检查站，按高度规划的空间秩序排列。Yoon Hwitak 借助殖民档案与幸存者证言，对合作社的建筑设计作了富有洞见的描述。

每个合作社都被一圈土筑或木筑的防御墙围住，墙头往往装有铁丝网。墙的高度与宽度取决于该地区的战略重要性及抗日力量的威胁程度。例如，间岛省满洲国合作社的蓝图——以朝鲜人合作社为范本——显示防御墙高2.7米、宽1米。在另一个省，尺寸分别为3米与2米。防御墙的每个角上建有一座炮楼，最多可容五人向外面的敌人射击。每个合作社一般配备四至九座炮台。有些情况下，合作社四周距墙15至20米处还设置高2至5米的铁丝网。
en: The architectural apparatus of the agrarian cooperatives gave a visual form to the power relations between colonized and colonizer. The spatial design of each cooperative entailed a self-enclosed village that acted as a type of social quarantine. The gates, roads, identical houses, collective facilities, and checkpoints were arranged in a highly planned spatial order. Yoon Hwitak insightfully describes the architectural design of the cooperatives, drawing on both colonial documents and survivors’ testimonies.

Each cooperative was circumscribed within a defensive wall built of soil or wood and often topped with barbed wire. The height and width of the wall depended on the strategic importance of the area and the level of threat from anti-Japanese forces. For example, the blueprint of the Manchukuo state’s cooperatives in Kando Province, which were modeled after the Korean cooperatives, shows a defensive wall 2.7 meters high and 1 meter wide. In another province, the dimensions were 3 and 2 meters, respectively. A turret was built at each corner of the defensive wall, where as many as five people could fire at enemies outside. Each cooperative, in general, was equipped with four to nine gun batteries. In some cases, barbed wire 2 to 5 meters high was placed around a cooperative, 15 to 20 meters from the wall.

zh: 合作社通常有四座大门，其中至少两座又窄又矮，连接进出村落的小通道。出于监视目的，只指定一座大门供日常使用，夜间关闭。从大门到合作社中心的道路约六米宽。据一份日本文件的描述，正如早期美国城镇围绕教堂而建，每个合作社中心都有一个公共广场，警察署、自卫团本部、学校、保健所及其他公共设施坐落其间。中心的空地留作体育训练或紧急集会之用。一些合作社中心还设有一座十八米高的监视塔。道路连接村落四面八方，用于运粮。道路把合作社内区划分为四个扇区，每个扇区预期容纳一口公共水井与二十五户，即全村总户数的四分之一。每户分得198至277平方码土地。为节约用地，禁止各户拥有菜园。
en: The cooperatives typically had four gates, at least two of which were narrow and short and connected to small passages leading in and out of the village. For surveillance purposes, a single gate was allotted for everyday use and was closed during the night. The road from the gates to the center of the cooperative was about six meters wide. Just as early American towns were built around a church, according to a description in a Japanese document, each cooperative had a public square at its center, where a police station, self-defense group headquarters, schools, health center, and other public facilities were positioned. Open space in the center was reserved for physical training or assembly in an emergency. A surveillance tower eighteen meters in height was also placed in the center of some cooperatives. Roads were connected to all sides of the village and were used for transporting grain. The roads divided the inner zone of the cooperative into four sectors, each of which was expected to accommodate one communal well and twenty-five households or one-fourth of the total number of households in the village. Each household was allotted 198 to 277 square yards of land. To economize on land use, households were prohibited from having a vegetable garden.

zh: 合作社的建筑设计，令人想起福柯所描述的全景敞视监狱的图景。
全景敞视监狱是一台创造并维持一种可见且可验证的权力关系的机器，这种关系“独立于行使它的人”。
它拆解了“看／被看”的二元：
在周边环形建筑中，人完全处于他人的视线之内，却完全看不到观察者；在中央塔楼中，人看见一切，却从不被看见。”
满洲农业合作社中强加的空间秩序产生了类似效果，使社员形成自己时刻被监视的感知。这一空间机制或许可以解释，为何合作社内朝鲜人有组织的抗议或与日军的冲突少得惊人。虽然殖民政权并不排除使用武力，但空间秩序以及在场的军警也让殖民者的权力变得可见，使被殖民者可能将其内化。
en: The architectural design of the cooperatives evokes the image of the Panopticon along the lines described by Foucault.
A Panopticon is a machine that creates and sustains a visible and verifiable power relation “independent of the person who exercises it.”
It dissociates “the see/being seen dyad:
in the peripheric ring, one is totally seen, without ever seeing; in the central tower, one sees everything without ever being seen.”

The imposed spatial order in the agrarian cooperatives in Manchuria produced similar effects, creating the perception by members that they were always being watched. This spatial mechanism might account for the surprising paucity of Koreans’ organized protests or clashes with the Japanese forces within the cooperatives. Although the colonial power did not preclude the use of force, the spatial order, combined with the display of police and army personnel, also contributed to displaying the power of the colonizer, which could be internalized by the colonized.

zh: 殖民者与被殖民者的制度网络，构成了殖民政权的又一重空间秩序。正如合作社的建筑景观包含内置的全景敞视主义机制，制度网络也包含其资本主义特征内在的机制。如果说前者可见，后者则不可见。军事与警察力量等权力的外部手段，依赖压制人民、将其排除出社会秩序的否定性与惩罚性措施。另一方面，殖民制度的内在机制赋予殖民者与被殖民者新的梦想与欲望，从而生产出新的社会现实。金融资本、名义上的私有财产制度与共同体信用制度的相互作用，产生了经济理性、生产者的主体性，以及对新劳动过程的日常规制。
en: The institutional network of the colonizer and the colonized constituted yet another spatial order of the colonial power. As the architectural landscape of the cooperatives involved built-in mechanisms of panopticism, the institutional network entailed mechanisms immanent to its capitalist characteristics. If the former is visible, the latter is invisible. The external means of power, such as military and police force, relied on negative and punitive measures that repressed the people and excluded them from the social order. The immanent mechanisms of colonial institutions, on the other hand, endowed the colonizer and the colonized with new dreams and desires and thus, produced a new social reality. The interaction of finance capital, the fictive private property system, and the communal credit system produced an economic rationality, the subjectivity of producers, and the everyday regulation of a new labor process.

zh: 经济理性
en: Economic Rationality

zh: 殖民当局设想把无地的朝鲜人转变为独立小农。甚至在日本入侵满洲之前，东亚劝业株式会社就认为这种转变对于稳定受中国官员压迫的朝鲜人的生活是必要的。
1931年入侵满洲后，关东军也立即拟定了每年让 2,500 户朝鲜农户成为自耕农的计划：间岛1,200户，每户贷款500圆；其他地方1,300户，每户贷款750圆。
朝鲜的殖民当局承诺在1933年至1952年间，使间岛7,068户朝鲜农户取得土地所有权，每户平均贷款800圆。
en: The colonial authorities envisaged the transformation of landless Koreans into small independent farmers. Even before the Japanese invasion of Manchuria, the Asia Development Company considered such a transformation necessary to stabilize the lives of Koreans oppressed by Chinese officials.

Immediately following its invasion of Manchuria in 1931, the Kwantung Army also outlined its plan to create 2,500 independent Korean farmers every year: 1,200 in Kando, with loans of 500 won per household; and 1,300 in other places, with loans of 750 won per household.
The Korean state pledged to create 7,068 households of Korean property owners in Kando over twenty years from 1933 to 1952, providing an average loan of 800 won per household.

zh: 称为自耕农创定计划的贷款项目，以下列方式造就名义上的小土地所有者。在殖民当局的补贴下，开发公司购置土地。公司以贷款形式把土地租给朝鲜居民（难民与新定居者），不设宽限期。朝鲜人还获得住房、耕作及建设合作社其他费用的贷款。如果借款人在贷款期内——通常为十至二十年——每年偿付利息与部分本金，他们将获得土地所有权；后来规定地契由集体信贷组织保管。能够耕作的成年人数与牲畜数量，是界定社员资格的标准之一。贷款计划适用于合作社内外的农民。
en: The loan project called the Program to Create Independent Farmers functioned to create fictive small landowners in the following ways. With subsidies from the colonial authorities, the development companies acquired land. The companies leased it in the form of loans to Korean residents (refugees and new settlers) without moratoriums. Koreans were also provided with loans for housing, cultivation, and the other expenses of building the cooperatives. If borrowers paid the interest and a portion of the principal for every year during the term of the loan, usually for ten to twenty years, they would be granted title to the land; it was ruled later that the credit collectives would keep the titles. The number of adults able to farm and the number of livestock were among the criteria that defined eligibility for membership. The loan program was applied to peasants both inside and outside the cooperatives.

zh: 除了这一宣称的目标，贷款计划内在的信用制度还履行另一项功能。它使共同体主义理想的实施合理化，导致殖民政权对小土地所有者生产的最细微环节进行规划与规制。朝鲜总督府在间岛地区的政策——一系列贷款提案中较为温和的一项——展示了这一过程合理化的广度与细节。该政策以校准各种开支为基础，包括不同类型农田的成本，以及牲畜、耕作与住房的成本。利率定为8.2%，低于放债人收取的6%至20%的利率。虽然贷款额度部分取决于家庭人口数，每户预期平均获得800圆贷款：650圆用于共六町步土地（一町步水田与五町步旱田）；另有建房贷款（40圆）、购牛贷款（50圆）与农业费用贷款（60圆）。

children: 〔校注〕原文说 8.2% 低于放债人收取的 6% 至 20%。但 8.2% 位于这一区间内，数字照原书保留。

en: Beyond this stated objective, the credit system, which was intrinsic to the loan program, performed another function. It rationalized the implementation of the communitarian ideal, leading the colonial power to plan and regulate the most minor details of production by small landowning farmers. The policy of the Government General of Korea in the Kando region, a modest policy among a range of proposals on loans, demonstrates the breadth and detail of the rationalization of the process. This policy was based on calibrating various expenditures, including the cost of different types of farmland, as well as the costs of livestock, farming, and housing. The interest rate was set at 8.2 percent, which was lower than the 6 to 20 percent rates charged by moneylenders. While the amount of the loans depended in part on the number of household members, each household was expected to receive 800 won in loans on average: 650 won for a total of 6 chŏngbo land (1 chŏngbo of paddy fields and 5 of dry fields); and loans for building a house (40 won), purchasing an ox (50 won), and agricultural expenses (60 won).

zh: 贷款偿还时间表由贷款类型决定。利息与本金在不同年份、以不同期限偿还。用于农业开支的预借本金须在一年内还清，借款人有资格每年再借相同数额，最长三年。建房与购牛的本金须从第二年到第五年偿还，按年计息。按照满铁的计划，朝鲜农民预期在收获的第一年偿付土地贷款的利息；从第二年到第五年，公司收取交通、灌溉、工具、住房、道路及仓库等其他建筑贷款的本金。从第六年到第十二年，收取全部土地贷款本金，此后发放地契。
en: The loan repayment schedule was determined by the type of the loan. Interest and principal were repaid in different years for different periods of time. The principal advanced for agricultural expenses was to be repaid within one year, with eligibility to borrow the same amount every year for up to three years. The principal for building a house and purchasing an ox had to be repaid from the second to the fifth year, with annual interest. According to the smrc’s plan, Korean peasants were expected to pay the interest on loans made for land in the first year they harvested; from the second to the fifth year, the company would collect the principal on loans for transportation, irrigation, tools, housing, roads, and storage and other buildings. From the sixth to the twelfth year, all of the principal on loans for land was to be collected, after which the title deeds would be issued.

zh: 降低治理的经济成本，是信用制度的一个独特特征。通过对原始资本、贷款分配及其十五至二十年年度回报的细致计算，殖民当局决定每年建多少合作社、向社员预付多少贷款。投资回报可预期性的提高，使殖民政权得以设计一项持续二十年的政策。这种可预期性使资本得以经济地使用，最大化其预期效果。二十年间创造7,068户朝鲜小土地所有者，基于五年200万圆的投资及其余十五年370万圆的利息。200万圆原始资本的三分之一由朝鲜总督府提供，其余由东洋拓殖株式会社提供。1932—1936年最初五年的原始资本，预期创造共2,500户自耕农家庭：1933年1,000户，1934、1935、1936年每年500户。从合作社社员收取的利息将用于资助新贷款，在 1934 至 1936 年间让另外 279 户成为自耕农。1937年后，原始投资累积的利息足以创造更多有地家庭，直到1952年每年173至195户。换言之，原始资本投资到1936年即可收回；此后，偿还的本息每年再投资于该计划，直到1952年（见表5）。
en: The reduction of the economic cost of governing was a unique feature of the credit system. Through detailed calculation of the original capital, the distribution of loans, and their annual return over fifteen to twenty years, the colonial authorities determined how many cooperatives were to be built each year and the precise amount of loans to be advanced to the members. The increased predictability of the return on investment permitted the colonial power to design a policy that lasted twenty years. The predictability allowed for the economic use of capital, which maximized its intended effect. The creation of 7,068 households of Korean small landowners over twenty years was based on an investment of 2 million won for five years and its interest, 3.7 million won, for the remaining fifteen years. One-third of the original capital of 2 million won was to be provided by the Government General of Korea and the remainder by the Oriental Development Company. The original capital in the initial five-year period of 1932–36 was expected to create a total of 2,500 independent farming households: 1,000 households in 1933 and 500 annually in 1934, 1935, and 1936. The interest collected from the cooperative members would be used to finance new loans and create an additional 279 households from 1934 through 1936. After 1937, the interest accrued on the original investment would be sufficient to create more landowning households, between 173 and 195 every year until 1952. In other words, the original capital investment was to be recouped by 1936; after that, the repaid principal and interest would be reinvested in the program every year until 1952 (see table 5).

zh: 自耕农创定计划或多或少达成了目标。1933年至1935年，它在间岛共使 2,332 户成为名义上的有产户（合作社内776户、社外1,556户），相当于目标数的111%。这些家庭约占间岛全部朝鲜人家庭的33%、全部农田的21%。合作社内每户获得2.86町步土地，略少于计划；间岛合作社外的家庭获得5.1町步。
该计划到1937年扩展覆盖间岛2,906户；每户实际获得的贷款额（577.15圆）小于计划额（800圆）。
1937年至1940年，满洲全境共9,224户加入该计划，占地41,579町步，获得约610万圆贷款。
en: The Program to Create Independent Farmers more or less met its targets. From 1933 to 1935, it produced a total of 2,332 putatively property-owning households in Kando (776 households in the cooperatives and 1,556 outside them), or 111 percent of the target number. These accounted for about 33 percent of all Korean households and 21 percent of all farmland in Kando. Each household in the cooperatives received 2.86 chŏngbo of land, slightly less than planned, while households outside the cooperatives in Kando received 5.1 chŏngbo.
The program was extended to cover 2,906 households in Kando until 1937; the actual amount of the loan advanced to each household (577.15 won) was smaller than the planned amount (800 won).
A total of 9,224 households enlisted in the program across Manchuria from 1937 to 1940, occupying 41,579 chŏngbo and receiving about 6.1 million won in loans.

zh: 投资回报的可预期性，使治理技术规范化、普遍化。这种可预期性来自信用制度——与开发公司在创造小土地所有者之前实行的地租体系相比，它是一种更合理化、也更具强制性的风险管理形式。在自耕农创定计划实施之前，开发公司的行为如同地主，招朝鲜农民作佃户，并经常借钱给他们。在地租体系下，朝鲜农民须向开发公司缴纳收成的30%至40%。由于收成逐年变化，地租收入随之波动。这种波动使农民的缴纳不规律，导致投入土地的资本回报不可预期。东亚劝业株式会社把1932年损失一半资本归咎于中国东北政府的压迫——该政府原则上直到1931年都禁止朝鲜人与日本人拥有土地和居留。
但土地长期投资的性质，以及以地租形式收取利息的做法，想必也损害了公司有效管理其投资的能力。
en: The predictability of the return on investment regularized and universalized the technique of governance. The predictability was derived from the credit system, which was a more rationalized and coercive form of risk management than the ground rent system practiced by development companies before the invention of small landowners. Prior to the implementation of the Program to Create Independent Farmers, the development companies behaved like landlords, hiring Korean farmers as tenants and routinely loaning them money. Under the ground rent system, Korean peasants were required to pay development companies 30 to 40 percent of the harvest. As the size of the harvest varied by year, rental income fluctuated. Such variations rendered the peasants’ payments irregular, resulting in an unpredictable return on capital invested in land. The Asia Development Company attributed the loss of half its capital in 1932 to oppression by the Chinese government in the northeast, which in principle banned Koreans and Japanese from landownership and residence until 1931.
But the nature of the long-term investment in land and the collection of the interest in the ground rent form also must have compromised the company’s ability to manage its investments effectively.
