zh: 相比之下，信用制度要求农民或名义上的土地所有者每年偿付固定比例的本息，无论收成价值如何。我将回头讨论作为剩余劳动占有形式的信用制度，但先考察其深层动态。各种贷款的偿还时间表想必考虑了农民的偿还能力。然而，由于时间表定为十至二十年，经济理性似乎压倒了一年收成的不可预期性——后者正是影响农民偿付贷款能力的主要因素。这种估算长期投资回报的理性，使殖民政权得以为小土地所有者制定适当的生产方案。
en: In contrast, the credit system demanded that the peasants or fictive landowners pay a fixed proportion of the principal and interest every year, regardless of the value of the harvest. I will return to a discussion of the credit system as a form of appropriation of surplus labor, but first I will examine its underlying dynamics. The repayment schedules of various loans must have taken into consideration the peasants’ capacity to repay them. As the schedules were set for ten to twenty years, however, economic rationality seemed to take precedence over the unpredictability of annual harvests, which was the main factor affecting the ability of peasants to make their loan payments. This rationality in estimating the long-term return on investment enabled the colonial power to develop an appropriate scheme of production for the small landowners.

zh: 殖民主体性
en: Colonial Subjectivity

zh: 合作社是普遍而多元地吸纳朝鲜人及其他族群与民族集团的象征——这些群体过去被排除在满洲社会之外。当朝鲜人被组织进所谓自给自足的农业合作社时，个人被转变为民族与帝国的臣民。朝鲜人被期望与满洲的其他族群与民族集团和谐共处，包括满族、汉族、蒙古族与日本人。由于不同类型的合作社把中国人与朝鲜人带入各自分离的社会空间，朝鲜人的各种群体（难民、居民、失业者、有无国籍合法证件的居民，以及在朝鲜与满洲经历各异的新移民）被同质化为未来的财产所有者。正如我在第四章所探讨的，满洲不同地区的难民与居民，在劳动与财产权方面经历各异，并在1931年的中国排朝暴乱中受苦。1936年起从朝鲜前来的移民，不仅与早先群体不同，彼此之间也在朝鲜的原籍地、稻作与旱作技能、移民类型上存在差异。为了使朝鲜人内部的这种差异正常化，合作社在失地者与未来土地所有者之间划出一条新的具体边界。正是通过合作社的贷款计划，朝鲜总督府试图把满洲与朝鲜两地的失地朝鲜人再领土化为未来的有地生产者，并固定其社会关系。
en: The cooperatives were the emblem of the universal and pluralistic inclusion of Korean and other ethnic and national groups, which had been excluded from Manchurian society in the past. When Koreans were organized in putatively self-sufficient agrarian cooperatives, individuals were transformed into national and imperial subjects. Koreans were expected to live harmoniously with other ethnic and national groups in Manchuria, including the Manchus, Han Chinese, Mongols, and Japanese. As the different types of cooperatives brought Chinese and Koreans into separate social spaces, various groups of Koreans (refugees, residents, the unemployed, residents with or without legal documentation of nationality, and new immigrants, whose experiences in Korea and Manchuria differed) were homogenized as prospective property owners. As I explored in chapter 4, the refugees and residents in different parts of Manchuria had varied experiences of both work and property rights and had suffered during the Chinese riots of 1931. Immigrants coming from Korea from 1936 onward differed not only from the earlier groups but also among themselves in terms of their places of origin in Korea, skill in rice and dry farming, and type of immigration. To normalize such variation among Koreans, the cooperatives drew a new, concrete boundary between displaced and prospective landowners. It was through the loan program of the cooperatives that the Government General of Korea attempted to reterritorialize displaced Koreans in both Manchuria and Korea as prospective landowning producers and to fix their social relations.

zh: 朝鲜人拥有土地的普遍愿望，与他们逃离混乱失序的渴望结合在一起。殖民臣民的形成，内在包含着建构农民对殖民统治同意的社会过程。土地所有权的幻想迫使被殖民的朝鲜人回应殖民当局的召唤。自耕农创定计划以各种用途的贷款安置农民，如购地、建房与初期耕作费用。换言之，它是通往财产所有权的官方途径。财产所有权是一种承诺，使朝鲜居民忍受移居满洲、迁往指定地区的艰辛过程。
怀着免于饥饿、获得自己土地的希望，朝鲜移民离开家人、亲属与祖坟。他们的希望建立在开发公司普及的宣传与口号之上：“满洲到处都是无主的肥沃土地”；“第一年的口粮与种子，以及交通费用，均可贷款”；“只要辛勤劳作几年，人人都能成为土地所有者”；“我们建好房屋等着你们。”
en: The universal desire of Koreans to own land was combined with their aspiration to escape chaos and disorder. Inherent in this production of colonial subjects was the social process of constructing the peasants’ consent to colonial rule. The fantasy of landownership compelled colonized Koreans to respond to the calls of colonial authority. The Program to Create Independent Farmers accommodated peasants with loans for various purposes, such as purchasing land, building houses, and the initial expenses of cultivation. In other words, it was the official path to property ownership. Property ownership was a promise that led Korean residents to endure the grueling process of immigrating to Manchuria and relocating in the areas designated for them.

In the hope that they could avoid starvation and acquire their own land, Korean immigrants left family members, relatives, and ancestral burial sites. Their hopes were based on propaganda and slogans popularized by the development companies: “Unclaimed and fertile land is everywhere in Manchuria”; “grain and farming seed for the first year, as well as transportation fees, will be loaned”; “by working diligently for only a few years, everyone can be a landowner”; and “we are waiting for you with houses ready.”

zh: 土地所有权的承诺，为殖民政权确立对朝鲜农民的主权奠定了基础。这一承诺使殖民政权得以干预劳动过程，因为朝鲜人的集体搬迁与移民构成了组织耕作所需集体劳动的基础。灌溉工程是集体任务中最紧要的。早春冰层一融化，农民便开始修建灌溉设施，为耕作做准备。为了把水引到田里，他们搬运树枝、石块与土袋，在冰水中一连劳作数日。灌溉田地需要开挖从最近的河流延伸数英里的水渠。田地须在五月末六月初播种。有些家庭用牛拉犁，另一些则靠铁锹、锄头与镰刀耕作。
en: The promise of landownership became the pedestal on which the colonial power constructed its sovereignty over Korean peasants. This promise enabled the colonial power to intervene in the labor process, as the relocation and immigration of Koreans in groups formed the basis for organization of the collective labor necessary for farming. Irrigation projects were the most essential of the collective tasks. When ice began to melt in early spring, peasants began to work on them in preparation for farming. To divert water to the fields, they moved branches, stones, and bags of soil, working for days in the icy water. Irrigating the fields required digging channels that could run several miles from the nearest river. Fields had to be sown from late May to early June. Some households used ox-drawn plows, while others depended on spades, hoes, and sickles to work the land.

zh: 移民与搬迁政策把私有财产所有权呈现为殖民政权家长式的施舍。殖民者基于对购地、粮食、牲畜、农具及其他必需品成本的理性估算，为朝鲜人的移民与搬迁提供资本。私有财产所有权的幻想，使被殖民者为虚幻的承诺而在当下劳作。殖民主权要求以土地与所分田地的产出作为施舍，来满足耕作者的期望。虽然幸存者证实朝鲜农民冒生命危险为抗日游击队藏匿部分收成，但他们集团部落中的日常作息，仍受确保口粮、偿还债务、拥有土地这一稳妥前景的支配。
当这一期望落空时，他们的抗议便遭遇日本军警的权力与权威。移民要求新的种子贷款、治疗因缺乏饮用水与卫生设施而肆虐的传染病，以及前往城市的自由。耕种旱田者要求迁往可以从事稻作的地区。
en: The immigration and relocation policy represents private property ownership as a paternalistic handout from the colonial power. The colonialists provided the capital for the immigration and relocation of Koreans based on a rational estimation of the costs of purchasing land, grain, livestock, farming tools, and other necessities. The fantasy of private property ownership led the colonized work in the present in pursuit of an illusory promise. Colonial sovereignty required that the expectations of the cultivators be met with handouts of land and the products of the allotted fields. Although survivors attested that Korean peasants risked their lives to hide part of their harvests for the anti-Japanese guerrilla armies, daily routines in their collective villages remained governed by the sound prospect of securing their staple grains, paying their debts, and owning land.

When this expectation was not met, their protests were met with the power and authority of the Japanese military and police. The migrants demanded new loans for seeds, treatment of the contagious diseases made rampant by the lack of potable water and sanitation, and freedom to travel to the cities. Those who cultivated dry fields demanded relocation to areas where they could engage in rice farming.

zh: 名义上的私有财产权孕育了一种新模式的资本主义。合作社被发明出来，以抵御资本主义现代化给乡村带来的弊病。它们体现了一种共同体主义，宣称要否定商品化，进而否定殖民资本主义本身——其贸易、剩余占有与政治支配。决定社会关系的商品化基石，是为市场交换而生产。脱离所生产品使用价值、纯粹为市场交换而生产，是劳动异化与社会关系对象化的条件。即便社会计划被设想为扩大生产者对其产品生产与分配之权力范围的途径，评估其主权的一个关键问题仍是：谁的需要、感受或思想将占上风来塑造这一关系？
合作社的首要驱动力是扩大农业生产，而这正是殖民政权持续的首要需要。当国家被称为对土地拥有“最高”所有权时，这不是对其保护私有财产所有权之道德义务的隐喻，而是其对土地、人民与资本之控制的表示。
en: Fictive private property ownership bred a new mode of capitalism. The cooperatives were invented as a defense against the ills that capitalist modernization brought to the countryside. They embodied a communitarianism that claimed to negate commodification and by extension colonial capitalism itself—its trade, appropriation of surpluses, and political domination. The cornerstone of commodification, which determines social relations, is production for market exchange. Production exclusively for market exchange, separate from the use value of products generated, is a condition for the alienation of labor and the objectification of social relations. Even if social programs were envisioned as a way to extend the scope of the power of producers over production and distribution of their products, a question key to assessing their sovereignty is: Whose need, feeling, or thought will prevail to shape the relationship?

The primary drive of the cooperatives was to expand agricultural production, which was the primary ongoing need of the colonial power. When the state was said to have the “highest” ownership of land, it was not a metaphor for its moral obligation to protect private property ownership but an indication of its control of land, people, and capital.

zh: 这一殖民欲望的时刻指向一种看似将要成为现实的非资本主义形式，却仅存在于表象中。合作社在强化资本主义的同时否定资本主义。这种对资本主义的否定，是通过诉诸其对立面来重塑资本主义的过程。共同体社会关系的光环有其明确界限。合作社虽承诺培育超越资本、土地与劳动之商品交换的新社会关系，却只是把殖民者与被殖民者之间、资本与劳动之间的不平等关系，置换为债权人与债务人之间的金融交易。合作社承诺建立一个能消除地主与商人暴虐的新社会体系。结果，它们把无产者与有产者之间的关系，转变为渴望拥有自己土地的生产者与主要关心扩大农业生产的殖民国家权力之间的关系。乡村民族发展的共同体主义观念，催生了殖民国家与殖民臣民之间新的不平等关系。在本章结论中，我将讨论这种对社会关系的共同体主义颠倒如何为殖民法西斯权力奠定基础。
en: This moment of colonial desire pointed to a would-be non-capitalist form, yet only in representation. The cooperatives negated capitalism even while they reinforced it. Such negation of capitalism is the process of refiguring capitalism by invoking its opposite. The aura of communal social relations had its clear limit. While the cooperatives promised to foster new social relations beyond the commodity exchange of capital, land, and labor, they merely displaced the unequal relationships between colonizer and colonized and between capital and labor into a financial transaction between creditor and debtor. The cooperatives promised to establish a new social system capable of eliminating the tyranny of landlords and merchants. Instead, they transformed the relationship between the propertyless and the propertied into a relationship between producers, who desired their own land, and the colonial state power, which was primarily interested in the expansion of agricultural production. The communitarian notion of national development of the countryside gave rise to new, unequal relations between the colonial state and colonial subjects. In the conclusion of this chapter, I discuss how this communitarian inversion of social relations laid the groundwork for colonial fascist power.

zh: 强制的技术
en: Techniques of Coercion

zh: 合作社把两种强制机制制度化，殖民政权借此组织新的劳动过程：信用制度与农务契的共同体形式。信用制度的规训权力是正式的、契约性的，而农务契的规训权力来自习惯框架。在信用制度中，制度基础是各户与开发公司之间的契约，受法律与国家政策的保护和规制。在农务契中，原有的集体互助习惯被用来组织集体偿还贷款。殖民政权本可以在劳动过程中直接动用武力来削弱生产者的权利，例如规制种植作物的种类与劳动时间表。但殖民政权通过信用制度与农务契，取得了可比的效果，甚至对劳动力实现了更严格的控制。
en: The cooperatives institutionalized two mechanisms of coercion through which the colonial power organized a new labor process: the credit system and a communal form of the Mutual Aid Association. The disciplinary power of the credit system was formal and contractual, while the disciplinary power of the Mutual Aid Association was derived from a customary framework. In the credit system, the institutional foundation was the contract between individual households and development companies, which was protected and regulated by law and state policies. In the Mutual Aid Association, customary practices of collective support were devolved to the collective loan payment. The colonial power could have attenuated producers’ rights with the direct application of force in the labor process, such as regulating the types of crops to be cultivated and labor schedules. But the colonial power achieved comparable effects or even stricter controls over labor power with the credit system and Mutual Aid Association.

zh: 既有研究主要从债务增长如何使本来有望取得地权的农民陷入近乎奴役的境地这一角度，探讨贷款计划的影响。虽然许多幸存者把移居满洲视为经济机会，满铁与开发公司所做的调查却凸显了殖民政权的剥削。
en: Existing studies have explored the effects of the loan program primarily in terms of the ways in which growing debt reduced prospective landowners to something like slaves. While many survivors saw immigration to Manchuria as an economic opportunity, surveys conducted by the smrc and the development companies underscored the exploitation by the colonial power.

zh: 据朝鲜总督府的一份报告，安全农村的各户很好地遵守了贷款偿还时间表，1934年偿付了应还额的64%至108%。
其他调查记录了不断上升的债务，因为一般而言，贷款与其他债务的偿付超过了家庭平均收入。例如，1937年安全农村每户平均收入在324至586圆之间时，当年应还的贷款部分（用于土地、住房及合作社建设的其他开支）与其他债务分别相当于收入的33%与74%至118%。
1937年实施自耕农创定计划的安全农村，其贷款偿还率极不均衡。1938年与1939年偿还的贷款额远低于应还额。1940年的偿还额超过往年，尽管1937年至1940年这些安全农村的社员数下降了20%以上。
据说，各户每年偿还应还的贷款与其他债务，却只是为了借新债来应付生活与农业开支。孙春日指出，债务遍及满洲。为促成高贷款偿还率，朝鲜农民被允许种植鸦片。他们还被要求把收成总量的10%、鸦片销售收入的50%与副业收入的10%存入信用组合。
en: According to a report of the Government General of Korea, the households in the safety villages complied well with the payment schedule of the loans, paying 64 to 108 percent of the required return in 1934.

Other surveys recorded rising debt, as in general the payments on loans and other debts exceeded the average income of households. For instance, when the average income per household ranged between 324 and 586 won in the safety villages in 1937, the required portion of the loan payment in that year (for land, housing, and other costs spent on the construction of the cooperatives) and other debts amounted to 33 percent and 74 to 118 percent of income, respectively.

The rate of repayment of loans in the case of the safety villages, where the Program to Create Independent Farmers was implemented in 1937, was very uneven. The amount of the loans repaid in 1938 and 1939 was far below the required amount. The 1940 return exceeded previous returns, even when membership in these safety villages from 1937 to 1940 declined by more than 20 percent.

It was said that each year households repaid the required portion of their loans and other debts only to take out new loans to meet their living and agricultural expenses. Son Ch’unil states that debt was widespread across Manchuria. To facilitate the high rates of repayment of loans, Korean farmers were permitted to grow opium. They were also required to save 10 percent of the total harvested crops, 50 percent of opium sales, and 10 percent of supplementary income in the credit unions.

zh: 关于家庭的经济数据有助于评估农民经济，却不足以得出全面结论。经济调查没有探讨负债程度与决定家庭收入及消费的其他因素之间的相关性，例如每户分得的农田数量、土地类型（如水田、旱田或新近转为耕地的荒地）、劳动力数量、田地与合作社之间的距离，以及薪柴与副业等额外收入来源的可得性。我关心的与其说是实际债务额，不如说是其前一阶段——对劳动与贷款偿付的制度性与共同体性控制。高贷款偿还率与新债务的双重推进，表明了对合作社家庭成员控制的有效性。日常规训涉及信用制度与共同体协会的机制。
en: The economic data on households are useful in assessing the peasant economy but inadequate for reaching a comprehensive conclusion. The economic surveys did not explore the correlation between the degree of debt and other factors determining household income and consumption, such as the amount of farmland distributed to each household, the type of land (e.g., rice field, dry field, or wasteland recently converted into arable land), number of laborers, distance between the fields and the cooperatives, and availability of sources of extra income such as firewood and supplementary work. My concern is not so much the actual amount of debt as the stage preceding it—the institutional and communal control of work and the payment of loans. The dual progression of high rates of loan repayment and new debt indicates the effectiveness of the control over household members of the cooperatives. Everyday discipline involved the mechanisms of the credit system and the communal associations.

zh: 合作社使社会必要劳动时间同质化，没有什么比自耕农创定计划中制定的信用制度更能象征这一点。在政治层面，信用制度是一项包容性措施，把朝鲜人作为生产者与财产所有者整合进来。在经济层面，信用制度是占有剩余劳动的市场机制。由于农民劳作所得的收成收入用来抵偿贷款，殖民政权对其剩余劳动的占有，被视为保障贷款利息所必需的正当行为。在社会层面，信用制度强制人们付出达到社会必要水平的劳动，迫使个人竭尽全力劳作、偿还贷款，从而拥有土地。信用制度使殖民机构得以通过非人格化、官僚化的剥夺形式进行干预。这些贷款收取的利息，就其占有农民所创剩余价值的方式而言，类似于对土地收取的地租。但一个重大区别是：投资与回报周期的计算，开始支配农民的劳动时间量，而非相反。地租体系的投资回报不规律、不可预期，受制于逐年收成；信用制度却显得合法、理性而客观。信用制度授权了一种比地租体系更具强制性与惩罚性的控制形式。
en: The cooperatives homogenized the socially necessary time of labor, and nothing could be more emblematic of this than the credit system formulated in the Program to Create Independent Farmers. At the level of politics, the credit system was an inclusive measure that integrated the Koreans as producers and property owners. At the level of economics, the credit system was the market mechanism for the appropriation of surplus labor. Since the harvest proceeds of the farmers’ labor were credited to loans, the colonial power’s appropriation of their surplus labor came to be seen as legitimate actions necessary to secure the interest on the loans. At the level of society, it enforced the socially necessary labor, compelling individuals to work their hardest, repay their loans, and thus own land. The credit system enabled the colonial apparatuses to intervene through impersonal and bureaucratized forms of expropriation. The interest charged on these loans was similar to the ground rent charged on land in terms of the ways that they appropriated the surplus value created by the farmer. Yet a major difference is that the calculation of the cycle of investment and return came to dictate the amount of labor time of peasants rather than vice versa. While the ground rent system involved an irregular and unpredictable return on investment subject to the annual harvest, the credit system appeared to be legal, rational, and objective. The credit system authorized a form of control even more coercive and punitive than the ground rent system.

zh: 满洲实行两种地租。一种基于收成的固定百分比，另一种基于收成的固定数量。前者称为定租（chŏngjo），1920年代在奉天省、1931年以前在北满广泛实行。地主的份额在租约中并不固定，而是取决于收成大小。
这意味着地主从增产中获益，但也须承担一定风险。在信用制度下，佃农（或所谓财产所有者）独自承担风险，因为无论收成大小，他们都须偿付固定数额的本息。信用制度看似类似于基于固定收成数量的地租体系，因为偿付额不取决于收成。然而，信用形式基于对长期金融投资及其回报的计算。信用制度是一种私有化手段：债务人可预期的分期偿付，使开发公司得以规划利润的再投资。农民被迫遵守起始日期与期限各异的详细偿还时间表。

children: 〔校注〕本处把按收成固定比例缴租称为 chŏngjo。第一章把 chŏngjo 用于定额缴租，把按比例缴租称为 chipcho。两处术语对应关系依原书保留。

en: Two kinds of ground rents were practiced in Manchuria. One was based on a fixed percentage and the other on a fixed volume of the harvest. The former, called chŏngjo, was widely practiced in Fengtian Province in the 1920s and North Manchuria prior to 1931. The landlords’ share was not fixed in a leasehold but depended on the size of the harvest.

This meant that landlords benefited from an increase in production but also had to bear some risk. Under the credit system, tenants (or putative property owners) absorbed the risk alone, since, regardless of the size of the harvest, they had to pay a fixed amount of principal and interest. The credit system appeared to be similar to the ground rent system based on the fixed volume of the harvest, because the amount of the payments did not depend on the harvest. However, the credit form was based on calculation of long-term financial investment and its return. The credit system was a means of privatization whereby the predictable installment payments by debtors permitted development companies to plan their reinvestment of profits. The peasants were forced to comply with detailed repayment schedules with different start dates and lengths.

zh: 朝鲜移民独自承担风险，面临不确定性，却被禁止离开合作社、出售土地或将其传给他人。因此，他们别无选择，只能试图通过最大化生产中的劳动投入来规避风险。信用制度与土地所有权的承诺相结合，对劳动过程施加强制，比地租契约更甚，却无需时时刻刻的干预。即便殖民政权并不要求稻作，朝鲜农民仍偏好稻作——尽管它劳动密集——因为它收成更好、利润更大。虽然劳动被强化，但这种私有化形式——地主与所谓未来土地所有者之间的关系——不能像朝鲜人合作社的历史研究所主张的那样，被称为半封建的、或封建主义与资本主义共存的实例。相反，它是私有财产与信用制度的一种历史特殊形式。
en: Korean immigrants faced uncertainty by assuming the risk alone, yet they were prohibited from leaving the cooperatives, selling land, or passing it on to others. They therefore had no option but to try to circumvent risk by maximizing the input of their labor in production. The credit system, in combination with the promise of landownership, imposed coercion on the labor process more strongly than ground rent contracts did without moment to moment intervention. Even when rice farming was not required by the colonial power, Korean peasants preferred it, despite its labor-intensiveness, because it yielded a better harvest and larger profits. Although labor was intensified, this form of privatization—the relationship between landlords and putative prospective landowners—cannot be termed semifeudal or an instance of the coexistence of feudalism and capitalism, as historical studies of Korean cooperatives contend. Instead, it was a historically specific form of the private property and credit systems.

zh: 农务契把信用制度与共同体统治融合在一起，是对朝鲜团队合作习俗的再造——农民在其中为耕作、丧葬及其他需要大量劳力或金钱的事务提供互惠支持。以改善朝鲜人生活为官方使命，农务契围绕自治的需要而建立，自治被认为是解决农民失地问题的办法。满洲再造的团队合作实践与贷款计划相结合，据说旨在支持人民与朝鲜人共同体，以对抗地主的高利贷与商人的市场垄断。它还被宣传为族群与民族集团集体统治的工具，而这正是满洲国政权的政治意识形态。
en: Fusing the credit system with communal rule, the Mutual Aid Association was the reinvention of the Korean custom of teamwork, in which peasants provided reciprocal support for farming, funerals, and other events that required a significant expenditure of labor or money. With the official mission to improve Korean’s lives, the Mutual Aid Association was built around the need for self-rule, which was believed to be a cure for the displacement of peasants from the land. The reinvented practices of teamwork in Manchuria, combined with the loan program, were said to be intended to support the people and the Korean community as opposed to landlords’ usury and merchants’ monopoly of the market. It was also promoted as an instrument for collective rule of ethnic and national groups, which was the political ideology of the Manchukuo state.

zh: 私有财产制度与农务契是同一枚硬币的两面。一面吸引梦想个人拥有土地的人，另一面吸引重视共同体的人。共同体统治本来就有两面性。即便在先前，它也与其说是集体赋权的形式，不如说是背负佃租与其他债务的农民求生的最后手段。无论传统互助的本质如何，共同体统治在满洲被抽象为一种反资本主义策略。于是，共同体的生存策略被浓缩为贷款偿付这一核心机制。在自耕农创定计划于南满、北满实施之前，农务契教育社员耕作知识，运营学校与医疗设施。随着满鲜拓殖株式会社成立、1936年后把该计划扩展到这些地区，农务契主要经办贷款偿还的管理。
年度贷款偿还的执行不需要警察权力之类的外部力量。规训权反而从警察转移到农民集体。农务契强制执行农作物的集体收割与销售、贷款的集体偿付。合作社的每户须把全部收成（扣除指定家用量）上交给其农务契。农务契防止各户囤积农作物。农务契用农作物集体上市销售的利润，偿付全体社员家庭应还的贷款部分及其他集体开支，然后把剩余利润分配给各户。
农务契利用共同体网络，成为收取利息的低成本工具。
en: The private property system and the Mutual Aid Association were two sides of the same coin. One side appealed to those with dreams of individual landownership, while the other appealed to those who valued community. Communal rule was by definition ambiguous. Even previously it was not so much a form of collective empowerment as the last resort for survival of peasants burdened with tenancy rent and other debts. Whatever the essence of the traditional mutual aid, communal rule became abstracted into an anticapitalist strategy in Manchuria. Communal survival strategies, then, were condensed into the essential mechanism of loan payments. Before the Program to Create Independent Farmers was implemented in South and North Manchuria, the Mutual Aid Association educated its members about farming and operated schools and medical facilities. With the establishment of the Manchuria-Korea Development Company, which expanded the program to these areas after 1936, the Mutual Aid Association primarily handled the management of loan repayments.

Enforcement of the annual loan repayment did not require external forces like police power. The right to discipline was instead shifted from the police to the peasant collectives. The Mutual Aid Association enforced the collective harvest and sale of crops and the collective payment of loans. Each household in the cooperative was required to submit to its Mutual Aid Association its entire harvest less an amount specified for domestic consumption. The Mutual Aid Association prevented individual households from hoarding their crops. With profits from the collective sale of crops on the market, the Mutual Aid Association paid the portion of loans required of all member households, as well as other collective expenses. Then it distributed the remainder of the profits to each household.
The Mutual Aid Association tapped the communal network, becoming a lowcost instrument through which interest payments were collected.

zh: 农务契在满洲朝鲜人共同体中的再造，与朝鲜发生的情况相似。1930年代朝鲜农村振兴运动期间，一种称为乡约（Hyangyak）的农民共同体组织被安插到各村。与满洲的农务契一样，乡约以集体耕作、集体购销与设施共享的形式促进农民共同体的自治。在两种情况下，共同体集体的理念都把强制动态塑造为互助与集体统治。它们力图把地主与佃农之间的冲突关系转变为和谐关系。但农务契与乡约有所不同。前者原则上由独立小农组成，后者则由佃农构成；前者试图再造农民文化，后者受儒家传统启发，强调爱国与对国家和君主的忠诚。
en: The reinvention of the Mutual Aid Association among the Korean community in Manchuria was similar to what occurred in Korea. During the days of the agricultural revitalization movement in the 1930s in Korea, a peasant community organization called the Hyangyak was installed in villages. Like the Mutual Aid Association in Manchuria, the Hyangyak promoted self-rule of the peasant community in the form of collective farming, collective sale and purchase, and sharing of facilities. In both cases, the idea of communal collectives shaped the coercive dynamics as mutual aids and collective rule. They sought to transform the conflictual relationship between landlords and tenants into a harmonious one. But the Mutual Aid Association and Hyangyak differed. The former in principle consisted of small independent farmers, while the latter comprised tenants, and the former attempted to re-create peasant culture, while the latter, inspired by the Confucian tradition, stressed patriotism and loyalty to the state and ruler.

zh: 农务契以共同体自治的名义被接纳，实际日益成为管理还贷的机构。未能按期偿付者虽免于失去土地的威胁，却暴露于对其日常生活及生产与消费过程的集体监视之下。合作社中的共同体自治，是诉诸一种经典的强制形式，把强迫履行的义务变成看似由集体自愿承担的责任。农务契对合作社社员执行一种新的集体规训。其贷款管理活动揭示了私有财产权、理性与自治在实际制度中的含义，激起了被殖民者对这些事物的渴望。其明确宣称的目标与其功能并不一致。
en: Embraced in the guise of communal self-rule, the Mutual Aid Association became identified with the management of loan payments. Those who failed to make the required payments were saved from the threat of losing their land but were exposed to collective surveillance over their everyday lives and the processes of production and consumption. Communal self-rule in the cooperatives was a recourse to a classic form of mandatory compulsion, inverting coercion into collective voluntarism. The Mutual Aid Association performed a new collective disciplining of cooperative members. Its loan management activities exposed the meaning of private property ownership, rationality, and self-rule, which heightened the desire of the colonized. Its explicitly expressed objectives were inconsistent with its function.

zh: 总之，殖民主权与主体性建立在两重同时发生的颠倒之上。一重是共同体主义颠倒：小土地所有者的财产关系按集体统治原则组织起来。名义上的私有财产权、信用制度与共同体协会这些不可见机制，使殖民者得以占有合作社中朝鲜人的剩余劳动。除了这一资本积累功能，这些机制还以集体统治的乌托邦理想之名组织生产者的日常生活，使合作社自身承担贷款偿付的责任，即便没有直接的、时时刻刻的干预。殖民臣民的形成，与其说是向小农灌输企业家精神，不如说是创造能够按期偿清贷款的负责任的生产者。合作社不再是知识分子所构想的共同体主义乌托邦理想。相反，乌托邦理想被提炼为殖民治理术的核心体现。另一重颠倒，是把殖民者与被殖民者之间的关系转译为债权人与债务人之间的金融关系——这一转变以资本主义形式使殖民支配实质化。他们的信用关系体现了这种关系的颠倒，造成一种表象：开发公司收取本息是其投资的正当回报。殖民者与被殖民者之间的金融关系，在社会层面确证了殖民者对被殖民者劳动力的支配。
en: In sum, colonial sovereignty and subjectivity rested on two simultaneous inversions. One was the communitarian inversion, in which the property relations of small landowners were organized by the principle of collective rule. Its invisible mechanisms of fictive private property ownership, the credit system, and communal associations enabled the colonizer to appropriate the surplus labor of Koreans in the cooperatives. Beyond this function of capital accumulation, these mechanisms, in the name of the utopian ideal of collective rule, organized the everyday lives of producers so that the cooperatives themselves assumed responsibility for the loan payments, even without direct, moment to moment intervention. The formation of colonial subjects was less about instilling entrepreneurship in small farmers than about creating responsible producers capable of paying off loans on schedule. Cooperatives were no longer the utopian ideal of the communitarianism coined by intellectuals. Instead, the utopian ideal was distilled into the essential embodiment of colonial governmentality. The other inversion was the translation of the relationship between the colonizer and the colonized into a financial relationship between creditor and debtor—a transformation that substantiates colonial domination in a capitalist form. Their credit relationship embodied an inversion of this relationship, creating the appearance that the development companies’ collection of principal and interest was a legitimate return on their investment. The financial relationship between the colonizer and the colonized socially validated the domination of the colonizer over the labor power of the colonized.

zh: 社会危机的重复
en: a repetition of the social crises

zh: 殖民治理术遭遇了自身诡异的反面。在金融资本的机器——名义上的私有财产制度与共同体信用制度——驱动下，合作社的殖民政策承诺建立一种新的生产与消费体制。这些机器为殖民者与被殖民者双方确立了新的主体性与权力；人们在实际生活中一边应对使社会关系同质化的要求，一边又加固了等级秩序。当殖民者与被殖民者渴望创造社会关系的新空间配置时，等级暴露了殖民治理术的无效。等级表明，合作社让本应由共同体主义合作社解决的社会对抗再次出现。所谓的解决实际上制造了不满与排斥。吊诡的是，使人离开土地恰恰是合作社防止人口流动的技术的一环。这种流离的重复，揭示了资本主义现代性的时间维度。
en: Colonial governmentality encountered its own uncanny reverse. Driven by the machines of finance capital—the fictive private property system and the communal credit system—the colonial policy of the cooperatives promised to install a new regime of production and consumption. The machines instated a new subjectivity and power for both colonizer and colonized; the lived experience of them negotiated the demand to homogenize social relations at the same time as it reinforced hierarchy. When the colonizer and the colonized aspired to create a new spatial configuration of social relations, the hierarchy exposed the ineffectiveness of colonial governmentality. The hierarchy reveals that the cooperatives fostered a repetition of the very social antagonism that communitarian cooperatives were expected to resolve. The supposed resolution in fact produced discontent and exclusion. Displacement of people from land was paradoxically integral to the anti-nomadic techniques of the cooperatives. This repetition of displacement discloses the temporal dimension of capitalist modernity.

zh: 等级的轴线
en: The Axes of Hierarchy

zh: 族群与民族成员之间的等级轴线，由土地从一个群体向另一个群体的转移、以及各群体获得贷款的不平等机会与不同类型的贷款所决定。放贷实践已在第四章讨论。这里集中讨论土地从中国与朝鲜居民向日本与朝鲜难民及新移民的不公平转移。合作社的优先选址，原则上是安全区以外的国有土地与荒地——这些土地易于获取，且有助于农业发展。然而，以维护治安为名，开发公司剥夺了许多所有者的土地，有时不予补偿，或宣称无法确认所有者身份。
满洲国政权1932年与1936年进行的两次土地调查，使许多地主失去土地，正如1910年至1918年在朝鲜所做的那样。当土地所有者被要求出示地契登记时，许多人没有地契，或多个地主持有同一块土地的地契。大片土地的所有者不明的情形并不罕见。
在许多情况下，当土地所有者没有合适地契时，满洲国政权就迫使他们出售或出租土地，阻止其确立所有权。即便提供补偿，也少得让土地所有者视之为掠夺或武装入侵。提供现金补偿时，地价定得远低于市价，付款还常常拖延。
en: The axes of hierarchy among ethnic and national members were determined by the transfer of land from one group to another, as well as unequal access to loans and different types of loans for the different groups. Loanmaking practices were discussed in chapter 4. Here the discussion concentrates on the inequitable transfer of land from Chinese and Korean residents to Japanese and Korean refugees and new immigrants. The preferred sites for the cooperatives were, in principle, state-owned land and wasteland outside of the security areas, land that could be easily acquired and could contribute to agricultural development. However, in the name of enforcing security the development companies dispossessed many owners of their land, sometimes without compensation or with the declaration that the owners could not be identified.

The two land surveys conducted by the Manchukuo state in 1932 and 1936 divested many landlords of their lands, as they did in Korea from 1910 to 1918. When landowners were required to present their titles for registration, many of them had no title or multiple landowners had deeds to the same land. It was not unusual for the owners of large tracts to be unknown.

In many cases when landowners did not have proper deeds the Manchukuo state pressured them to sell or lease their land rather than establish ownership. Even when compensation was offered, it was so inadequate that landowners equated it with plunder or armed invasion. When cash compensation was offered, the price of the land was set much lower than the market price and payment was often delayed.

zh: 例如，东亚劝业株式会社1935年在吉林省以每 ssang 耕地2圆、荒地1圆的价格购地，而当地市价分别为58.4至121.4圆与41.4至60.7圆。1936年，该公司每 ssang 耕地与荒地分别支付8.2圆与2圆，而市价分别为120圆与40圆。面对地价的这种极端贬低，一些所有者拒不出售，把地契藏在房屋墙壁里。关东军士兵经常动用武力完成土地交易，破门入户搜查产权文件。在一个案例中，士兵枪杀了拒不执行卖地命令的一家八口。1934年3月依兰（Ŭiran）县土龙山（Toryongsan）村一场有名的抗争中，一群中国农民袭击了一支士兵队伍，以阻止土地交易。
东亚劝业株式会社1933年在黑龙江省购地时，命令所有者到遥远的哈尔滨一处警察分所领取补偿款。据报道，扣除旅费与在哈尔滨等待数周领款的食宿费用后，补偿所剩无几。

children: 〔校注〕ssang 是土地面积单位的转写。原书第五章原注 32 将 1 ssang 折作 6 段，具体汉字对应未能确认，保留原书转写。

en: For example, the Asia Development Company acquired arable land at 2 won and wasteland at 1 won per ssang in 1935 in Jilin Province, where the market price ranged from 58.4 to 121.4 and 41.4 to 60.7 won, respectively. In 1936, the company paid 8.2 and 2 won for arable and wasteland per ssang, while the market prices were 120 and 40 won each. In the face of this extreme devaluation in the price of land, some owners refused to sell and hid their titles inside the walls of their houses. The Kwantung Army soldiers often used force to complete land transactions, breaking into houses to search for property documents. In one case, the soldiers shot to death all eight members of a family that disobeyed the order to sell its land. In a well-known riot in Toryongsan Village in Ŭiran County in March 1934, a group of Chinese peasants attacked a contingent of soldiers to put a stop to land transactions.

When the Asia Development Company purchased land in Heilongjiang Province in 1933, it ordered the owners to pick up their payments at a police substation in distant Harbin. The compensation reportedly did not amount to much after the deduction of travel expenses and lodging in Harbin, where the owners had to wait weeks for their payments.

zh: 一些朝鲜难民与新移民被送往从未耕种过土地的地区。但其中一些人也定居在中国人曾居住耕作的地区。这虽然逆转了此前中国人与朝鲜人之间的关系，两个群体却仍然彼此对立。满洲国政权建立之前，朝鲜人的土地曾在禁止外国人拥有土地的民族主义政策下，被中国政府与地主侵占。满洲国时期，关系逆转，朝鲜新旧移民常被迁往中国人（有时是朝鲜人）先前居住的地区。据当地民众回忆，朝鲜定居者到达分配的土地与房屋时，发现房间与厨房灶台还是温热的，表明原住户被赶走是刚刚才被匆匆赶走。例如，1938年东边道辉南（Hwinam）县，满鲜拓殖株式会社以微薄补偿把中国农民逐出土地，租给从朝鲜全罗道移来的210户朝鲜家庭。据说，这种流离过程就像一块石头从原位滚落，把其他石头也从它们的位置撞落。
en: Some Korean refugees and new immigrants were sent to areas where the land had never been farmed. But some of them also settled in areas where Chinese had lived and farmed. Whereas this reversed the previous relationship between the Chinese and Koreans, the groups remained opposed to each other. Prior to the establishment of the Manchukuo state, Koreans’ land had been appropriated by the Chinese government and landlords under a nationalist policy that barred foreigners from owning land. During the Manchukuo period, the relationship was reversed, as old and new Korean immigrants were often relocated in areas that the Chinese (and sometimes Koreans) had formerly inhabited. Popular memory recalls that Korean settlers arriving at their assigned land and houses found that rooms and kitchen stoves were still warm, indicating how recently and quickly the former occupants had been driven out. For example, in Hwinam County in Tongbyŏndo in 1938 the Manchuria-Korea Development Company removed Chinese peasants from their land with little compensation and leased it to 210 Korean households that had immigrated from the Cholla Province of Korea. It was said that this process of displacement was like a stone rolling from its place, dislodging other stones from theirs.

zh: 虽然一些朝鲜人从定居政策中获益，另一些人的土地却落入日本移民手中，他们因此流离失所。如果生产力未经证实的未耕地不适合对移民政策反应冷淡的日本新移民，朝鲜人拥有的水田便被分配给他们。一些朝鲜人辗转去了别处。一些留了下来，为新日本移民作佃农与农业劳工。例如，1937年至1941年186户日本家庭定居大日向（Ohinata）村时，满洲拓殖公社购买了该村约一半的水田，分配给日本移民。这个村被日本媒体广泛报道为模范农场；其日本移民把获授土地的约60%出租给佃农，按三等土地质量收取地租。佃农还须缴纳税款与灌溉费用。一些朝鲜人也被雇为稻作劳工，领取月薪与胶鞋、烟草、衣物、粮食等实物报酬。
在另一个村，日本移民把所得土地的一半以上租给先前拥有或耕种这些土地的中国人和朝鲜人。
en: Although some Koreans benefited from the settlement policy, others lost their land to Japanese settlers and were displaced. If untilled land with unproven productivity was unsuitable for new Japanese immigrants, whose reaction to the immigration policy was lukewarm, rice fields owned by Koreans were distributed to them. Some Koreans drifted away. Some remained, working as tenants and agricultural laborers for the new Japanese settlers. For instance, when 186 Japanese households settled in Ohinata Village from 1937 to 1941, the Manchuria Development Corporation bought about half of the total rice fields in the village to distribute to the Japanese settlers. This village was widely reported as a model farm in the Japanese media; its Japanese settlers leased to tenants about 60 percent of the land they had been granted, charging rent on the basis of three grades of land quality. Tenants were required to pay taxes and irrigation expenses. Some Koreans were also hired as laborers for rice farming and received monthly wages and in-kind payments such as rubber shoes, tobacco, clothing, and grain.
In another village, Japanese settlers rented more than half of the land they had received to the Chinese and Koreans who formerly had owned or cultivated it.

zh: 农业合作社政策原则上禁止社员转租土地。对这一原则的违背，可归因于实施中碰到的具体情况，例如日本移民少于计划、农业劳动力短缺，以及满洲的耕作条件（土地质量、灌溉与天气）对日本移民而言陌生。但比较朝鲜与日本移民定居的地区可以发现，转租做法可能并非无心之失。琼斯解释说，满鲜拓殖株式会社1936年至1939年为朝鲜移民定居选定的区域，与日本移民定居区域重叠。
琼斯把这种重叠归因于朝鲜人与日本人都擅长稻作，以及朝鲜人对日本人的协助。据他所言：“朝鲜人被用来为日本殖民者铺路，承担土地的初步开垦与水田的整理；日本人到来之后，朝鲜人又充当与中国当局交涉的中间人、劳工，有些情况下还作日本人的佃农。没有朝鲜人扮演这些角色，受补贴的日本农业定居点恐怕永远不会扎根。”
看来，作为被奉为满洲开发主导者的群体，日本移民从定居与财产转移的链条中获益最多。
en: The policy of agrarian cooperatives, in principle, prevented members from subleasing land. Infringement on this principle can be attributed to contingencies in the implementation process, such as Japanese immigrants being fewer than planned, a shortage of farm labor, and the fact that Manchuria’s farming conditions (land quality, irrigation, and weather) were unfamiliar to Japanese settlers. But a comparison of the areas that Korean and Japanese immigrants settled suggests that the practice of subleasing may not have been inadvertent. Jones explains that the zone chosen by the Manchuria-Korea Development Company from 1936 to 1939 for the settlement of Korean immigrants overlapped the zone of Japanese settlement.

Jones attributed this overlap to the skill of both Koreans and Japanese in rice farming and to the assistance the Koreans provided to the Japanese. According to him, “Koreans were utilized to pave the way for the Japanese colonists by undertaking the initial clearing of the land and preparing the rice fields, while after the arrival of the Japanese, the Koreans served as intermediaries with the Chinese authorities, as labourers and in some cases as tenants of the Japanese. Without Koreans in these roles, the Japanese subsidized agricultural settlements probably never would have taken root.”
It would seem that as the declared leaders in developing Manchuria the Japanese immigrants benefited most from the chain of settlement and property transfer.

zh: 流离
en: Displacement

zh: 与贷给朝鲜人和日本人的贷款额度差距、以及中国人无法获得贷款相伴随，土地从一个族群向另一个族群的转移，在它们之间制造了等级。这一等级暴露了殖民治理术的无效——它力图使生产与交换的社会关系合理化、同质化、合法化。它加剧了满洲农民脱离土地——这正是殖民政权据称力图消除的现象。难民与新移民的搬迁使其他人脱离土地。这种链条效应导致中国人与一些朝鲜居民社会地位下滑。虽然难以评估流离的全部影响，但可以从统计与轶事中推断。中国史学指出，满洲国初期佃农与农业劳工分别约占农村总人口的26%与30.3%，到满洲国后期分别增至34%与49%。
佃农的负担也加重了，因为地主把土地税与其他税负转嫁给佃农。
据幸存者讲述，土地被征用安置移民时，他们被迫立即离开。失去土地时，他们也被剥夺了住房——那些房屋被用来安置新移民。流离者仅有的选择是：到别处作佃农、找份工作、住在荒野，或迁往山区。
en: In tandem with differences in the size of loans advanced to Koreans and Japanese and the unavailability of loans to Chinese, the transfer of land from one ethnic group to another created a hierarchy among them. This hierarchy exposed the ineffectiveness of colonial governmentality, which sought to rationalize, homogenize, and legalize the social relations of production and exchange. It furthered the displacement of peasants from land in Manchuria—exactly what the colonial power purportedly had sought to eliminate. The relocation of refugees and new immigrants displaced others from land. This chain effect led to the downward mobility of Chinese and some Korean residents. Although it is hard to assess the full impact of displacement, it can be inferred from statistics and anecdotes. Chinese historiography states that tenants and agricultural laborers at the beginning of the Manchukuo period constituted about 26 and 30.3 percent, respectively, of the total rural population, while they increased to 34 and 49 percent in the late Manchukuo period.
The burden on tenants also increased, as landlords transferred the cost of land and other taxes to tenants.

According to survivors’ accounts, they were forced to leave immediately when their land was appropriated for the settlement of immigrants. When they lost their land, they were dispossessed of their homes, which were used to house the new settlers. The only options for the displaced were to become tenants elsewhere, find employment, live in the wilderness, or move to the mountains.

zh: 新的流离链条也是朝鲜人共同体的一个首要问题。协和会的朝鲜人代表把流离视为对满洲国政治原则的威胁。1939年9月30日至10月10日在新京（Sinkyŏng）〔校注：原文括注为“哈尔滨”，新京即今长春。〕举行的协和会全国会议上，十六名朝鲜人代表主张，新移民政策是以牺牲朝鲜居民为代价推行的。

社会不稳的首要原因是土地失给新移民。当朝鲜人定居的地区被选为新定居点时，朝鲜人别无选择，只能离开自己辛勤开垦而有了产出的土地。协和会年会上的一位代表概述了这一困境：如果中国人可以坚持保留自己的土地，朝鲜人却因地位不稳而不敢拒绝出售自己的土地。虽然政府官员叫朝鲜人等到新移民到来再走，他们却往往离开，因为收回土地毫无指望。在一个例子中，这种局面使某地区560户朝鲜家庭以及约70户失地家庭陷入忧惧。虽然官方政策是为新移民购买未耕地，县官员却不遵守这些规定。另一位代表主张，移民计划应使用未耕地；若要购买朝鲜人已耕作的可耕地，就应提供充分补偿。代表们还呼吁殖民政权加快与土地所有者的谈判，使失地农民得以在荒地或未耕地上耕作。此外，朝鲜人代表希望通过教导节俭与忍耐的美德来减少这种流离，使农民安于其地、其业、其土。
en: The new chain of displacement was a primary problem for the Korean community as well. The Korean representatives of the Concordia Association perceived displacement as a threat to the political principles of the Manchukuo state. During the national meeting of the Concordia Association in Sinkyŏng (Harbin) from September 30 to October 10, 1939, sixteen Korean representatives argued that the new immigration policy had been undertaken at the expense of Korean residents.

The primary cause of social instability was the loss of land to new immigrants. When an area settled by Koreans was chosen as a place for new settlement, Koreans had no choice but to leave the land that they had made productive. A representative at an annual meeting of the Concordia Association outlined the dilemma: if the Chinese could insist on keeping their land, Koreans could not afford to refuse to sell theirs because of their insecure status. While government officials told Koreans to stay until new immigrants arrived, they tended to leave since they had no prospects of regaining their land. In one example, this situation created apprehension among the 560 Korean households in an area, as well as about 70 households who lost their land. Although the official policy was to purchase uncultivated land for new immigrants, county officials did not follow these rulings. Another representative contended that the immigration project should use uncultivated land or offer sufficient compensation if arable land already worked by Koreans was to be purchased. The representatives also appealed to the colonial power to expedite negotiations with landowners so that displaced peasants could farm on wasteland or uncultivated land. In addition, the Korean representatives wished to reduce this displacement by teaching the virtue of saving and patience so peasants would become bound to place, job, and land.

zh: 未能处理佃租问题，也表明合作社无法承担从民族层面解决帝国社会危机的任务。1939年，协和会的朝鲜人代表指出，不稳固的佃租契约是流离的另一大来源。即便契约写明五至六年的佃租期，地主两三年后就换佃农、与出价最高者签约的情形也不罕见。随着更多朝鲜人在“自由”移民政策或分散计划下来到满洲，准佃农的增加加剧了这一痼疾。代表们指出地主与佃农之间的紧张：前者拥有土地的合法所有权，后者对灌溉设施拥有某些权利。
en: The failure to address the tenancy issues also denotes the ineffectiveness of cooperatives in serving as the national resolution of the social crises in the empire. In 1939, the Korean representatives of the Concordia Association identified the insecure tenancy contract as another major source of displacement. Even when the contract stated a five- or six-year tenancy period, it was not rare for landlords to change tenants after two or three years, contracting with whomever would pay the most rent. The increase in prospective tenants, with more Koreans arriving in Manchuria under the “free” immigration policy or the dispersed program, aggravated this perennial problem. The representatives pointed out the tension between landlords and tenants, with the former possessing legal ownership of land and the latter having some rights to irrigation facilities.

zh: 由于地主通常拒绝提供任何协助，佃农自己出工并支付灌溉费用，因而保留灌溉权利。这使他们即便未经地主同意，也能对佃租权的转移行使某些权力。据说，谁获得水权，谁就成为真正的佃农，即便没有地主批准。此外，有些情况下地主不知道自己的实际佃农是谁，因为原佃农常把佃租权连同水权一起交易。当殖民政权试图以把佃租契约延长至五年以上的法律解决这一佃租冲突时，朝鲜人代表要求殖民政权将佃租纠纷由民事审理改归刑事管辖。虽然财产权的不稳固是资本主义体系的核心，朝鲜人代表却未把它设定为资本主义的危机。他们在该会的意识形态领域内把这些关切表述为威胁满洲国、进而威胁日本帝国统一的问题。他们相信，这些问题若得不到妥善处理，就会成为日本帝国的危机，破坏共同体的和谐共存。
en: As landlords usually refused to provide any assistance, the tenants themselves paid for the labor and expenses of irrigation and thus kept the rights to it. This allowed them to exercise certain powers, even without the consent of landlords, over the transfer of tenancy. It was said that whoever acquired the water rights would become the real tenants, even without the landlords’ approval. Moreover, in some situations landlords did not know who their actual tenants were because the original ones often traded their tenancy along with the water rights. When the colonial power tried to resolve this tenancy conflict with a law extending tenancy contracts to more than five years, the Korean representatives asked that the colonial power move the jurisdiction of tenancy conflicts from civil to criminal law. Although the insecurity of property rights was at the heart of the capitalist system, the Korean representatives did not postulate it as a crisis of capitalism. They articulated these concerns within the ideological domain of the association as problems threatening the unity of Manchukuo and thus the Japanese empire. They believed that if these problems were not adequately addressed they would become a crisis for the Japanese empire and would disrupt the harmonious existence of the community.

zh: 资本主义政治
en: Capitalist Politics

zh: 朝鲜人内部的差距，使人不能把等级轴线归因于民族政治。正如本章所探讨的，满洲国政权、朝鲜总督府与关东军分别宣称代表中国人、朝鲜人与日本人。这些所谓民族国家权力彼此竞争追逐自身利益，并宣称代言其民族臣民的身份与利益。结果，为日本定居设计的政策优先于朝鲜定居政策。按等级转移土地，以及中国人、朝鲜人与日本人在合作社相关收益上的差距，可能反映了民族国家权力之间的不平等。然而，使一些朝鲜居民与另一些朝鲜居民及新移民对立的土地按等级转移表明，等级并非仅仅源于民族政治。
en: The disparity among Koreans precludes attribution of the axes of the hierarchy to national politics. As this chapter has explored, the Manchukuo state, the Government General of Korea, and the Kwantung Army claimed to represent Chinese, Koreans, and Japanese, respectively. These putative nation-state powers competed against one another in pursuing their own interests and claimed to speak for the identities and interests of their national subjects. As a result, the policies designed for Japanese settlement took precedence over those for Korean settlement. The hierarchical transfer of land and the disparity among Chinese, Koreans, and Japanese in terms of the benefits associated with their cooperatives might reflect the unequal power among the nation-state powers. However, the hierarchical transfer of land, which pitted some Korean residents against other Korean residents and new immigrants, demonstrates that the hierarchy did not result exclusively from national politics.

zh: 等级必须置于资本主义扩张过程的背景之中。虽然开发公司以高于原购入价的价格把土地卖给借款人，资本主义的运作逻辑却超出了这种营利策略，其特征在于一种结构性矛盾：资本扩张同时使社会关系同质化与差异化。日本决策者承诺通过人民与土地的合理配置，结束朝鲜、日本与满洲农民的流离。这种经济的空间重组，要求满洲的地价、工资与生活费用显著低于朝鲜与日本。换言之，正是由于满洲的比较优势，来自朝鲜与日本的贫困农民才会在满洲成为有生产能力的劳动力，在那里生活与耕作比在朝鲜和日本更便宜。大卫·哈维所称的资本主义危机向外“空间修复”的这一方案，要求制造并再生产朝鲜、日本与满洲之间的地区差距。
en: The hierarchy must be situated within the context of the process of capitalist expansion. Although the development companies sold land to borrowers at prices higher than the original purchase price, capitalist dynamics exceeded this profit-making strategy. Capitalist dynamics are instead marked by a structural contradiction in which capital expansion simultaneously homogenizes and differentiates social relations. Japanese policymakers pledged to end the displacement of peasants in Korea, Japan, and Manchuria through the rational allocation of people and land. This spatial reorganization of the economies required that the price of land, wages, and living expenses in Manchuria be substantially less than in Korea and Japan. In other words, it was because of Manchuria’s comparative advantage that destitute peasants from Korea and Japan would become productive labor in Manchuria, living and farming more cheaply there than in Korea and Japan. This formula, which David Harvey calls the outward “spatial fix” of a capitalist crisis, required that regional disparities between Korea, Japan, and Manchuria be created and reproduced.

zh: 事实上，合作社的殖民政策在这一农业发展时期并未抬高满洲地价。相反，该政策通过强行侵占与不足补偿使土地急剧贬值。例如，满洲国政权与满洲拓殖公社所购土地中，有偿与无偿的比例几乎相当（见表6）。以资产贬值为手段的资本积累过程，为资本主义以殖民方式扩张提供了条件。通过维持更低的地价与农作物价格、消除高利贷与商人的市场垄断，满洲的耕作与家庭成本被保持在低于朝鲜与日本的水平。按等级转移土地是资本主义扩张的一个条件。而贷给满洲日本与朝鲜移民的贷款差距，则源于以日本人生活水平更高、更昂贵为由向其发放更大贷款的做法。
en: The colonial policy of the cooperatives did not, in fact, increase the price of land in Manchuria during this period of agricultural development. Instead, the policy dramatically devalued land through forceful appropriation and inadequate compensation. For instance, the proportions of paid and unpaid land were almost equivalent for land acquired by the Manchukuo state and the Manchuria Development Corporation (see table 6). The process of capital accumulation by means of devaluation of assets authorized a colonial mode of capitalist expansion. Farming and household costs in Manchuria were kept lower than in Korea and Japan by maintaining cheaper prices for land and crops and eliminating usury and the merchants’ monopoly of markets. The hierarchical transfer of land was a condition for capitalist expansion. And the disparity between loans made to Japanese and Korean settlers in Manchuria resulted from the practice of making larger loans to Japanese on the grounds that they had higher and more expensive standards of living.

zh: 结论：渗透与殖民法西斯主义的悖论
en: conclusion: a paradox of osmosis and colonial fascism

zh: 农业合作社的形成，是渗透政治中的一种新机制——渗透政治即人民跨境移动催生日本帝国民族扩张与资本主义扩张的具身过程。殖民政权把农民人口的再分配视为解决日本、朝鲜与满洲社会危机、培育这些地方有机统一的途径。两种不同的逻辑刻画了这种渗透政治：民族国家形成的逻辑，它把民族国家用作帝国的构件；以及资本的逻辑，它同时使帝国内各民族经济同质化与差异化。虽然渗透的殖民话语设定民族整合与资本主义整合的同构性，渗透政治却陷入一个悖论。第四、五章以这两个过程之间的紧张阐释了这一悖论。
en: The formation of the agricultural cooperatives was a new mechanism in the politics of osmosis or the corporeal process in which the movement of people across borders engendered the national and capitalist expansion of the Japanese empire. The colonial power saw redistribution of the peasant population as a way to resolve social crises in Japan, Korea, and Manchuria and cultivate the organic unity of these places. Two distinct logics characterize this politics of osmosis: the logic of nation-state formation, which utilized nation-states as building blocks of the empire; and the logic of capital, which simultaneously homogenized and differentiated national economies within the empire. Although the colonial discourse of osmosis posits the homology of national and capitalist integration, the politics of osmosis was caught in a paradox. Chapters 4 and 5 explicated this paradox in terms of the tension between the two processes.

zh: 第四章追踪了民族国家形成动态对满洲资本主义发展施加的限制。殖民当局（朝鲜总督府、关东军与满洲国政权）通过对居民与新移民搬迁的细致规划，使移民过程合理化。然而，它们相互竞争的民族利益损害了这类政策的效力。第五章追溯了渗透政治的另一过程——资本主义发展同时促进又约束满洲民族国家形成的种种方式。矛盾的力量是资本主义发展过程的核心。一方面，合作社使朝鲜人、中国人与日本人的社会生活同质化。金融资本的两项制度手段，即名义上的私有财产权和共同体信用制度，，使治理术合理化，建构民族臣民，规制生产与消费过程。这种同质化对应着满洲国政权各族群与民族集团和谐合作的意识形态，以及日本统一帝国的殖民意识形态。另一方面，朝鲜人内部以及各族群与民族集团之间在合作社收益上的等级，是资本主义差异化机制的显著表现。按照资本主义扩张的要求，朝鲜总督府、满洲国政权与关东军制造并维持朝鲜人、中国人与日本人在生活、耕作与搬迁成本上的差异。
en: Chapter 4 tracked the limits of capitalist development in Manchuria imposed by the dynamics of nation-state formation. Colonial authorities (the Government General of Korea, the Kwantung Army, and the Manchukuo state) rationalized the immigration process through detailed planning of the relocation of residents and new immigrants. Yet their competing national interests compromised the effectiveness of such policies. Chapter 5 traced the other process of osmotic politics—the ways in which capitalist development simultaneously facilitated and constrained nation-state formation in Manchuria. Contradictory forces were central to the process of capitalist development. On the one hand, the cooperatives homogenized the social lives of Koreans, Chinese, and Japanese. The institutional means of finance capital, fictive private property ownership, and the communal credit system rationalized governmentality, constructed national subjects, and regulated the processes of production and consumption. This homogenization corresponded to the Manchukuo state’s ideology of harmony and cooperation among various ethnic and national groups and the Japanese colonial ideology of a unified empire. On the other hand, the hierarchy among Koreans and between ethnic and national groups in terms of the benefits of the cooperatives was a spectacular manifestation of the capitalist mechanism that differentiated them. In accordance with the requirements of capitalist expansion, the Government General of Korea, the Manchukuo state, and the Kwantung Army created and maintained differences among Koreans, Chinese, and Japanese in terms of the costs of living, farming, and relocating.

zh: 满洲国时期的渗透政治，与资本主义扩张的民族梦想和殖民梦想处于辩证关系之中。殖民梦想是双重的：殖民者想象通过重新安置农民，让他们进入合作社，从而一举平息朝鲜、日本与满洲的所有社会危机；被殖民者则想象他们将确立对自己劳动的主权。在这一梦想框架内，合作社被视为一种社会方案，可以取代以所谓西方经验为范本的资本主义模式。伴随殖民梦想的是一个民族梦想。把合作社设想为替代性资本主义，基于一个成问题的假定：民族经济（日本的、朝鲜的或满洲的）可以与世界资本主义经济隔绝，资本主义现代化可以独立于中介而发展。
en: The politics of osmosis during the Manchukuo period stood in dialectical relation to national and colonial dreams of capitalist expansion. The colonial dream was twofold: the colonizer imagined pacifying all social crises in Korea, Japan, and Manchuria simultaneously through the spatial relocation of the peasants into the cooperatives; and the colonized imagined that they would establish their sovereignty over their own labor. Within the framework of this dream, cooperatives remained as a social alternative to the capitalist model exemplified by the putative Western experience. Accompanying the colonial dream was a national dream. Envisaging the cooperatives as an alternative capitalism was based on the problematic assumption that the national economy (Japanese, Korean or Manchurian) could be insulated from the world capitalist economy and that capitalist modernization could develop independent of mediation.

zh: 实际上，关于无中介经济的殖民与民族梦想，最后变成了法西斯国家施加控制的一种方式。国家借助新的强制机制，塑造了新的主体性。把农民搬迁进合作社——这一空间修复——并未解决危机，只是把生产者流离的问题转移到新边疆，从而推迟了危机。被殖民者被驱入一种新发明的共同体生产与交换体制，信用制度与共同体协会在其中决定他们的社会必要劳动。法西斯权力借共同体主义实现的反转，正是通过这种历史特殊的资本主义形式（金融资本、名义上的财产制度与共同体信用制度）完成的。
en: In actuality, the colonial and national dream of an unmediated economy was transmuted into an instance of control by the fascist state, which equipped itself with new coercive mechanisms that produced new forms of subjectivity. The relocation of peasants in the cooperatives—the spatial fix— did not resolve the crises but merely deferred them by transferring the problem of the displacement of producers to a new frontier. The colonized were driven into a newly invented communal regime of production and exchange, where the credit system and communal associations determined their socially necessary labor. The communitarian inversion of fascist power was accomplished through this historically specific form of capitalism (finance capital, the fictive property system, and the communal credit system).

zh: 二十世纪上半叶，农业共同体主义与日本及其他地方的法西斯国家权力结盟，后者力图提供一种新的资本主义未来。这种替代性资本主义被发明为危机的解决方案，宣称要消除资本主义体系的一切矛盾。当知识分子与决策者力图克服伴随工业化的商品化与异化时，共同体主义作为一种替代方案出现，意在否定商品化与异化。小农的集体自治，是在日本与朝鲜作为政治话语出现的农业共同体主义的主旨。这种替代性资本主义形式被强加于满洲这一新殖民地，以解决日本与朝鲜的危机。农业合作社体现了克服全球资本主义不确定效果的愿望，从而想象了一种与殖民资本主义相容形式的共同体生活。合作社结合了殖民资本主义的两个矛盾目标：维持资本积累的基础，以及通过社会计划争取这些生产者本人的拥护，唤起他们作为准财产所有者的新的民族与社会意识。来自朝鲜与日本的农民，以及满洲的朝鲜居民，被给予土地所有权的短暂承诺——它将确立他们对自己劳动的主权。殖民权力把其法西斯权力嵌入这种新社会关系的建构之中。
en: Agrarian communitarianism entered a partnership with fascist state powers in Japan and elsewhere in the first half of the twentieth century, which sought to offer a new capitalist future. This alternative capitalism was invented as a resolution of the crises and claimed to eliminate all contradictions in the capitalist system. As intellectuals and policymakers sought to overcome the commodification and alienation that accompanied industrialization, communitarianism as a negation of commodification and alienation emerged as an alternative. Collective rule by small cultivators was the main thrust of the agrarian communitarianism that emerged as a political discourse in Japan and Korea. This form of alternative capitalism was imposed in the new colony of Manchuria to resolve the crises in Japan and Korea. Agrarian cooperatives embodied the desire to overcome the indeterminate effects of global capitalism and thus imagined a communal life in a form compatible with colonial capitalism. The cooperatives combined two contradictory goals of colonial capitalism: to sustain the basis of capital accumulation and to animate the support of these very producers through social programs, invoking their new national and social consciousness as wouldbe property owners. Peasants from Korea and Japan, as well as Korean residents in Manchuria, were offered the momentary promise of landownership, which would establish their sovereignty over their labor. Colonial power embedded its fascist power in the construction of this new social relation.

zh: 农业合作社把渗透过程与殖民法西斯主义置于一种时间政治之中。合作社以推动生产和市场交换现代化、同时建立抵御商品市场冲击的保障为宗旨，由此重新界定了前现代与现代。它们驳斥了那种线性历史观——它把社会变迁理解为从封建主义向资本主义的演进、以及现代性从城市向乡村的扩散。相反，合作社被寄托于一个没有原始积累的资本主义乌托邦未来。正当它汲取这一民族与殖民梦想之时，满洲加速的资本主义转型却重复了农民脱离土地。被与实际交织的梦想所迷惑，这种反复失地的切身经历既如幻景，又有其具体的历史形态。
en: The agrarian cooperatives situated the osmotic process and colonial fascism within a politics of time. When cooperatives were provided with a rationale to modernize the process of production and market exchange and create safeguards from commodity markets, they reformulated the concepts of premodern and modern. They refuted the linear conception of history that understood social change in terms of the progression from feudalism to capitalism and the diffusion of modernity from city to countryside. Instead, the cooperatives were vested in a utopian future of capitalism without primitive accumulation. At the same time that it fed on this national and colonial dream, the accelerated capitalist transformation of Manchuria repeated the displacement of peasants from land. Bewildered by dreams intertwined with actuality, the lived experience of the repetition was as much phantasmagoric as historically specific.

en: Immigration and relocation took place between late fall and late winter, after the harvest and before planting. This means that Korean immigrants traveled to Manchuria without warm clothing to protect them from its harsh winter. For the recollections of Kim Yŏngsong and Ro Chŏngsuk on the process of relocation, see Lee Chŏngsu, “Ryangjach’on nongmindŭrŭi kangbak iju” (The Forced Migration of Peasants in Ryangja Village), in Chungguk Chosŏn minjok palchach’wi ch’ongsŏ, vol. 4, Kyŏlchŏn, 5–8. When the Japanese army relocated one hundred Korean households from five villages in Tongnyŏng County (southeast of Heilongjiang Province and adjacent to Kando and Fengtian Provinces) in 1935, the peasants were given five days to pack their belongings—pots, bowls, farming tools, grain, and blankets. They were required to assemble at a Japanese army base located seven to fifteen kilometers from their villages. Their village was burned after they left. After three days’ travel by train and on foot, they arrived at their newly designated settlement and slept on the concrete floor of mill houses or storage rooms until their houses were built. They even had to procure their own building materials, cutting and transporting wood from the forest to make house frames and then applying a mixture of tree branches, earth, and water to the roof and floor. For similar recollections collected in the same volume, see Ch’ae Tosik and Ch’ae Sŏnae, “Rajaguesoŭi iminsari” (A Life as Immigrants in Rajagu), in ibid., 19–23. According to these recollections, new houses were erected in their collective in four or five days. Built with such shabby materials, the houses developed frost inside the walls. It was not uncommon for the head of Korean villages to cheat immigrants of money that the development companies had provided to pay for the expenses of moving and building houses. See Sŏk Chŏngsong, “Ilbonimindanŭi t’oji yakt’al” (The Plundering of Land by the Japanese), in ibid., 24–26.
zh: 移民与搬迁发生在晚秋至晚冬之间，即收获之后、播种之前。这意味着朝鲜移民前往满洲时没有御寒衣物抵御严冬。关于 Kim Yŏngsong 与 Ro Chŏngsuk对搬迁过程的回忆，参见 Lee Chŏngsu, “Ryangjach’on nongmindŭrŭi kangbak iju” (The Forced Migration of Peasants in Ryangja Village), in Chungguk Chosŏn minjok palchach’wi ch’ongsŏ, vol. 4, Kyŏlchŏn, 5–8. 1935年日军把东宁县（Tongnyŏng County，黑龙江省东南部，毗邻间岛与奉天省）五个村庄的一百户朝鲜人搬迁时，农民只有五天时间收拾家当——锅、碗、农具、粮食与毯子。他们被要求到距村七至十五公里的日军基地集合。离开后村庄被烧毁。经过三天火车与步行旅程，他们到达新指定的定居点，在房屋建成之前睡在磨坊或仓库的水泥地上。他们甚至必须自备建材，从林中砍伐搬运木材做房架，再用树枝、泥土与水的混合物涂抹屋顶与地面。关于同卷收录的类似回忆，参见 Ch’ae Tosik and Ch’ae Sŏnae, “Rajaguesoŭi iminsari” (A Life as Immigrants in Rajagu), in ibid., 19–23. 据这些回忆，他们所在的集团部落四五天就盖起了新房。由于建材简陋，房屋墙壁内结霜。朝鲜村庄的头目骗取开发会社提供的搬迁与建房费用，并不罕见。参见 Sŏk Chŏngsong, “Ilbonimindanŭi t’oji yakt’al” (The Plundering of Land by the Japanese), in ibid., 24–26.

en: Choi Kansik, “Hwinam Chosŏn ijuminŭi nunmulgyŏwun saenghwal” (The Wretched Life of Korean Settlers in Whinam),” in ibid., 9–12. en: Chungguk Chosŏn minjok palchach’wi ch’ongsŏ, vol. 4, Kyŏlchŏn. This volume of an anthology on the history of Koreans in China offers various recollections of the experience of moving and farming in new places. For instance, Kim Yongmu remembers that, when his family and 99 other households settled in Sangjihyon County in Heilongjiang Province in 1939 the land was so fertile that it was like a dream harvest that only required weeding, sowing, and bringing water to the rice fields. Even dry farming yielded a bountiful harvest of millet, corn, beans, and potatoes, as well as watermelon and other fruits. With this promise of a rich reward, they worked strenuously and practically lived in the fields. Kim recalls that the joy and hope continued until Japan confiscated their harvest, imposing a mandatory minimum quota in 1941. See Hwang Hyŏngu, “Manggungnoŭi sŏrwum” (Sorrows of People without Nation), 40–46; and Kim Yongmu, “Sangjihyŏn Ojihyangesoŭi iminsari” (Life as Immigrants in Ojihyang Sangji County), 13–18.
zh: Chungguk Chosŏn minjok palchach’wi ch’ongsŏ, vol. 4, Kyŏlchŏn. 这部在华朝鲜人历史文选的该卷提供了在新地方搬迁与耕作经验的各种回忆。例如，Kim Yongmu记得，1939年他家与另外99户定居黑龙江省尚志县（Sangjihyon）时，土地如此肥沃，仿佛只需除草、播种、为水田引水，就能得到梦寐以求的好收成。即便旱作也丰收粟、玉米、豆类与土豆，还有西瓜等水果。怀着丰厚回报的期望，他们拼命劳作，几乎住在田里。金回忆，喜悦与希望持续到1941年日本没收其收成、强加最低配额之时。参见 Hwang Hyŏngu, “Manggungnoŭi sŏrwum” (Sorrows of People without Nation), 40–46; and Kim Yongmu, “Sangjihyŏn Ojihyangesoŭi iminsari” (Life as Immigrants in Ojihyang Sangji County), 13–18.
